paper.title: Prism-GRPO: Faster VLA Policy Optimization via Splitting Same-outcome Groups
paper.abstract: GRPO is increasingly used for reinforcement learning of vision-language-action (VLA) policies because, unlike PPO, it does not require training a critic. This simplification comes with a sampling cost: group-relative advantages require multiple rollouts from each scene. Under binary success rewards, groups whose rollouts all succeed or all fail have zero advantage and are discarded by dynamic sampling. These groups are especially common early in training, when most rollouts fail, wasting much of

summary.core_problem: 在二值成功奖励的 VLA/机器人 RL 中，GRPO 早期训练会因“同结果组”(全失败/全成功)优势为零而被丢弃，导致昂贵 rollout 预算被浪费、学习信号稀疏。
summary.importance: 属于后训练/策略优化层面的信号工程：在不引入 critic 的前提下，缓解 group-based policy optimization 在稀疏二值奖励下的采样低效问题；对用 GRPO/PPO 做对齐或具身策略优化的人有可迁移的技巧。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Prism-GRPO：在保持“任何成功都应高于任何失败”的排序约束下，为轨迹引入加权的执行质量分数，把同结果组拆成质量谱，从而让原本 advantage=0 的组也产生可用的相对优势；质量分数可来自接触信息、执行动作统计或视觉观测等，不依赖手工 progress reward；并给出理论性质（摘要声称不会增加某种风险/上界，但截断未给全）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务、模型规模、对比基线与数值提升；可预期对比对象为 GRPO 动态采样与可能的 PPO/GRPO 变体，指标为成功率/样本效率/rollout 成本。

summary_en.core_problem: With binary success rewards in VLA/robot RL, GRPO wastes expensive rollouts early on because all-success/all-failure groups yield zero relative advantage and get discarded, causing sparse learning signals.
summary_en.importance: A post-training/policy-optimization signal-shaping tweak: improves sample efficiency of group-based policy optimization under sparse binary rewards without adding a critic; potentially transferable to GRPO-style alignment or embodied policy learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Prism-GRPO augments the binary outcome with a weighted trajectory-level execution-quality score, splitting same-outcome groups into a quality spectrum while enforcing that every success still ranks above every failure; quality can be derived from contacts, executed actions, or visual observations (no hand-crafted progress reward). The abstract claims a theoretical guarantee (truncated).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide tasks, model sizes, baselines, or quantitative gains; likely compares against vanilla GRPO dynamic sampling (and possibly PPO/variants) on success rate and rollout/sample efficiency.

recommendation.zh: 这是“稀疏二值奖励下让 GRPO 别浪费 rollout”的小技巧；读动机和质量分数构造即可，没看到干净的数值与任务细节前别当通用结论。
recommendation.en: A pragmatic trick to stop GRPO from wasting rollouts under sparse binary rewards; skim the motivation and the quality-score construction, but don’t over-trust it without clean task details and numbers.

paper.title: FlashDrive: Flash Vision-Language-Action Inference for Autonomous Driving
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise to bring end-to-end reasoning to autonomous driving, but their computational cost remains far too high for real-time control. The core challenge is structural: VLA inference is not a single bottleneck but a cascade of four. Visual encoding wastes compute on overlapping video frames; language-model prefill recomputes context that could be carried over from the previous timestep; reasoning tokens are generated serially despite low entropy; and flow-match

summary.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action 模型用于自动驾驶时推理成本过高，且瓶颈不是单点，而是视觉编码、语言模型 prefill、推理 token 生成和 flow-matching 去噪四级串联。
summary.importance: 提出算法-系统协同设计框架，同时处理四个推理瓶颈，展示面向实时控制的 VLA 推理优化思路。
summary.technical_approach: FlashDrive 分别用时间重叠实现跨帧流式 KV-cache 复用；跨时间步携带上下文避免重复 prefill；利用驾驶域推理 token 的低熵和强块内相关性降低串行生成开销；对 flow-matching 速度场非均匀区域施加非均匀计算。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型名、延迟、加速比或基线数值，仅描述四类瓶颈和对应 shortcut。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action inference for autonomous driving is too expensive for real-time control because it has a cascade of four bottlenecks rather than one.
summary_en.importance: It proposes an algorithm-system co-design framework that addresses all four stages together, offering an engineering template for real-time VLA inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlashDrive uses temporal overlap for streaming KV-cache reuse across frames, carries over context to avoid recomputing LM prefill, exploits low entropy and strong intra-block correlations in driving-domain reasoning tokens, and allocates non-uniform compute to the non-uniform flow-matching velocity field.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model names, latency, speedups, or baseline numbers; it describes the four bottlenecks and corresponding shortcuts.

recommendation.zh: 把 VLA 推理拆成四个瓶颈并分别找 shortcut 的工程框架值得看，但自驾 domain 太重；只借思路，不必细读实验。
recommendation.en: The four-bottleneck decomposition of VLA inference is a useful engineering frame, but the autonomous-driving setup is too domain-specific; borrow the ideas, skip the detailed experiments.

paper.title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
paper.abstract: The prevailing recipe for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models couples a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert. This makes the VLM a context encoder rather than a decision-maker. We introduce G0.5, a pretrained autoregressive VLA in which a single transformer decoder emits reasoning and action tokens under a single objective. Three components make this tractable at foundation-model scale: a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer that maps heterogeneous robot ac

summary.core_problem: 主流 VLA 模型把预训练 VLM 与独立训练的 flow-matching 动作专家拼接，使 VLM 退化为上下文编码器而非决策者；G0.5 尝试用单一自回归流同时输出推理与动作 token。
summary.importance: 范式创新：把 VLA 从 VLM+flow expert 的双塔结构改为单 decoder 自回归生成 reasoning+action，对统一多模态建模有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 三个组件：(1) 可学习的 cross-embodiment action tokenizer，把异构机器人动作映射到共享词表；(2) 原生 chain-of-thought 流，把任务分解、物体 grounding、动作提示与动作 token 交错；(3) 视觉记忆模块，通过 vision encoder 注入数秒历史。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给具体参数量/数据量/数值对比；声称在指令遵循、动作粒度/任务视野/OOD 场景可由 prompt 直接控制。

summary_en.core_problem: Dominant VLA recipes couple a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert, reducing the VLM to a context encoder; G0.5 instead emits reasoning and action tokens from a single autoregressive decoder under one objective.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm contribution: moves VLA from a two-tower VLM+flow-expert design to a single-decoder AR generation of reasoning+action, relevant to unified multimodal modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three components: (1) a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer mapping heterogeneous robot actions into a shared vocabulary; (2) a native CoT stream interleaving task decomposition, object grounding, and action hints with action tokens; (3) a visual memory module injecting multi-second history through the vision encoder.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract gives no parameter count, data size, or numerical baselines; it claims instruction following and prompt-controllable action granularity, task horizon, and OOD scene handling.

recommendation.zh: 把动作离散化成 token 与文本 CoT 联合 AR 生成，思路与统一语言建模相关；只看 action tokenizer 和 CoT-action 交错设计两节即可。
recommendation.en: Discretizing actions into tokens and jointly AR-generating them with textual CoT is relevant to unified LM; read the action tokenizer and CoT-action interleaving sections only.

paper.title: Lost in Reconstruction: Aligning Action Representations with Language in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Action verbs describe not only the physical outcomes of actions, but also how those actions are performed. Yet action representations in vision-language-action models (VLAs) are typically optimized for reconstruction under L1/L2 losses in raw action space, where numerical proximity need not reflect linguistically meaningful distinctions. On BridgeV2, we show that action trajectories contain verb-grounding information beyond visual state changes, and that reconstruction-only discrete tokenization

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 VLA 里一个常被忽略的接口问题：动作表示通常按连续控制空间的重建误差来学，尤其是离散 action tokenizer 往往只优化 L1/L2 或 VQ 重建，但这种“数值上接近”并不等于“语言上同类”。结果是，动作轨迹里原本携带的 verb grounding 信息在离散化和压缩过程中被系统性抹掉，语言条件策略只能在一个已经失真的动作词表上继续学习。论文的核心问题因此不是机器人控制本身，而是如何让 action representation 在离散化时就保留与语言，尤其是动词语义，对齐的结构。
summary.importance: 对 LLM / 统一预训练研究的启发主要在表示层，而不是具体机器人 benchmark。很多多模态统一建模工作默认“先把非文本模态 token 化，再交给 AR LM”即可，但这篇文章提醒：tokenizer 如果只保真低层重建目标，可能会在进入统一 LM 之前就丢掉最关键的语义因子。这个问题和视觉 tokenizer、语音离散单元、world model latent code 的设计是同一类。论文的贡献量级属于“把 action tokenizer 从压缩器改成语义接口”，对做 native multimodal pretrain、VLA、以及任何把控制序列离散化进 LM 的工作都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
文章先做了两个诊断，再提出 SALT。第一个诊断是证明动作轨迹确实含有超出视觉结果的 verb 信息。作者把 verb grounding 拆成两部分：action goals，对应 episode 起止状态的视觉变化；motion dynamics，对应 7-DoF 连续动作轨迹。通过信息分析，他们发现两者各自都携带对方无法完全替代的 verb 信息，也就是说，单看图像前后状态不足以恢复动作语义，动作过程本身包含语言相关结构。

第二个诊断是现有离散动作表示会损伤这种结构。作者比较了 Bin tokenization、VQ-VAE tokenizer 和 FAST 等方案，考察 tokenized action representation 与 verb 之间的 mutual information。结论是：只按重建训练的 tokenizer 会系统性降低 verb 相关信息，而且压缩越强，损失越大。更重要的是，后续语言条件 policy training 不能完全把这部分结构补回来，说明瓶颈发生在 tokenizer 这一步，而不是 policy head 太弱。

在此基础上，作者提出 SALT，Semantically ALigned action Tokenizer。它以 VQ-VAE 风格 tokenizer 为基础，但在 tokenizer 训练阶段加入一个语言对齐辅助目标：把量化后的 action latent 输入一个冻结的预训练 VLM，让它生成对应 episode instruction。这样做的关键不是让 tokenizer 直接分类 verb，而是通过 instruction generation 这个更丰富的监督，把“被相似语言描述的动作”拉到更接近的离散表示，同时保留连续控制空间的重建能力。训练目标因此是 reconstruction / commitment / codebook loss 与 instruction-generation loss 的联合优化。这里选择冻结 VLM，而不是端到端共同训练，目的是把语言语义作为稳定教师信号注入 tokenizer 学习，避免 policy 训练阶段再去间接恢复。

从建模角度看，SALT 的重要区别在于：它把 action tokenizer 从单纯的压缩模块变成了跨模态语义瓶颈。相比 per-dimension binning，SALT 学的是组合式离散词表；相比 reconstruction-only VQ-VAE，它显式约束 codebook 保留语言可恢复性；相比 FAST 这类频域压缩+BPE，它不只追求序列压缩率，而是优先保留对 instruction 有用的结构。
summary.experiments:
实验分三部分。第一部分是语义诊断。作者在 BridgeV2 上分析 verb 信息来源，结论是视觉终态和动作轨迹都含有独立贡献，支持“动作模态需要单独对齐语言”的前提。第二部分是 tokenizer 信息损失分析。Across Bin、VQ-VAE、FAST，token 化后的动作表示与 verb 的 mutual information 都下降，且压缩越强下降越明显；这说明离散接口确实是语言 grounding 的瓶颈。第三部分是下游控制验证。作者在 SimplerEnv 中训练基于不同 tokenizer 的 policy，SALT 的平均任务成功率达到 71.9%，明显高于 reconstruction-only VQ-VAE 的 42.7%，也高于 FAST 的 31.2%。这个提升幅度足够大，说明语义对齐并不是只改善可解释性，而是实打实影响闭环控制。

摘要还提到，虽然辅助目标没有显式标注 verb，学到的 action vocabulary 仍会围绕 verb-relevant distinctions 组织起来。这通常意味着论文里应有 codebook 可视化、最近邻分析、instruction recoverability 或 token cluster 的语义分析。精读时应重点看这些定性结果，因为它们决定 SALT 到底是在学“语言相关动作原语”，还是仅仅借助额外监督提升了重建质量。另一个值得看的是消融：instruction-generation loss 权重、codebook size、压缩率、冻结 VLM 的选择，以及 policy 训练是否在不同 tokenizer 容量下保持公平比较。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读但要抓住主线。先看 Section 2 和 Section 3，确认作者不是直接上新方法，而是先证明两个前提：动作轨迹里有额外 verb 信息；现有 tokenizer 会把它丢掉。若这两步不成立，SALT 就没有必要。然后看 Section 4 的训练目标和结构图，重点理解为什么 supervision 放在 tokenizer 阶段，而不是 policy 阶段；以及为什么用冻结 VLM 从量化 latent 生成 instruction，能逼迫 codebook 保留语言可恢复性。最后看 Section 5 的 SimplerEnv 主结果和 tokenizer 语义分析。

预计 35-50 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。最值得停下来看的图表通常是：verb information decomposition、mutual information vs compression、不同 tokenizer 的成功率主表、以及 codebook / token cluster 的可视化。如果你关心统一多模态预训练，阅读时可以把 action token 换成 image / audio token 去想：同样的问题很可能也存在，只是动作模态把问题暴露得更明显。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a representation bottleneck in vision-language-action models: action tokenizers are usually trained to reconstruct continuous control trajectories under L1/L2 or VQ-style objectives, but numerical fidelity in action space does not guarantee preservation of linguistically meaningful distinctions. As a result, verb-grounding information present in trajectories is systematically degraded during discretization and compression, and downstream language-conditioned policy learning has to operate on an already distorted action vocabulary. The central question is therefore how to make action representations preserve language-aligned structure at the tokenizer stage, not only at the policy stage.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is broader than robotics. Many multimodal LM pipelines assume that once a modality is tokenized, an autoregressive model can absorb the rest. This paper shows why that assumption can fail: if the tokenizer is optimized only for low-level reconstruction, it may discard the semantic factors that matter most before the unified model ever sees them. That lesson transfers directly to visual tokenizers, audio discretization, and latent codes used in world models or unified multimodal pretraining. The contribution is best viewed as turning the action tokenizer from a compression module into a semantic interface.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first establishes two empirical diagnoses, then introduces SALT. The first diagnosis is that action trajectories contain verb information beyond visual state changes. The authors decompose verb grounding into action goals, represented by visual changes between episode endpoints, and motion dynamics, represented by the 7-DoF action trajectory. Their analysis shows that each carries verb-relevant information not fully captured by the other. This means that visual outcomes alone are insufficient; the action process itself contains language-relevant structure.

The second diagnosis is that existing discrete action representations erase this structure. The paper compares Bin tokenization, VQ-VAE tokenizers, and FAST, and measures the mutual information between verbs and tokenized action representations. Reconstruction-only tokenizers consistently reduce verb-related information, with stronger compression causing larger losses. Importantly, downstream language-conditioned policy training does not fully recover the missing structure, indicating that the bottleneck is created at the tokenizer interface rather than by an underpowered policy head.

SALT—Semantically ALigned action Tokenizer—is then built on top of a VQ-VAE-style tokenizer. During tokenizer training, the quantized action latents are fed into a frozen pretrained VLM, which is asked to generate the corresponding episode instruction. This adds a language-alignment objective to the usual reconstruction, commitment, and codebook losses. The point is not to classify verbs explicitly, but to force the codebook to preserve information that makes the original instruction recoverable. Actions described by similar language are therefore encouraged to occupy nearby or related discrete representations while maintaining control-space fidelity.

The key modeling difference is that SALT treats the tokenizer as a cross-modal bottleneck. Compared with per-dimension binning, it learns a compositional discrete vocabulary. Compared with reconstruction-only VQ-VAE, it explicitly constrains the codebook to retain language-recoverable structure. Compared with FAST-style frequency compression plus BPE, it prioritizes semantic preservation over compression alone. Using a frozen VLM as the teacher also stabilizes the language signal and avoids relying on downstream policy training to rediscover the missing semantics.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments have three parts. First, on BridgeV2, the paper analyzes where verb information comes from and shows that both visual endpoint changes and action trajectories contribute unique information. That supports the premise that action representations need their own language alignment rather than inheriting everything from vision-language pretraining.

Second, the paper studies information loss under tokenization. Across Bin, VQ-VAE, and FAST, mutual information between verbs and tokenized action representations drops, and the drop becomes larger under stronger compression. This is the core evidence that the discrete action interface is a semantic bottleneck.

Third, the paper evaluates downstream control in SimplerEnv. Policies trained with SALT reach 71.9% average task success, compared with 42.7% for a reconstruction-only VQ-VAE tokenizer and 31.2% for FAST. The gap is large enough to show that semantic alignment is not merely improving interpretability; it materially affects closed-loop control performance.

The abstract also notes that although the auxiliary objective does not explicitly label verbs, the learned action vocabulary becomes organized around verb-relevant distinctions. In the full paper, the most informative evidence here is likely to be codebook visualizations, nearest-neighbor analyses, instruction recoverability, or token-cluster semantics. Those qualitative analyses matter because they reveal whether SALT is truly learning language-aligned action primitives rather than simply benefiting from extra supervision. The most useful ablations to inspect are the weight of the instruction-generation loss, codebook size, compression level, the choice of frozen VLM, and whether policy comparisons are capacity-matched across tokenizers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a good skim paper, but the logic matters. Start with Sections 2 and 3, because the method only makes sense if two premises hold: trajectories contain verb information beyond visual outcomes, and standard tokenizers destroy part of it. Then read the SALT method section and the training objective carefully. The key question is why the semantic supervision is applied during tokenizer learning rather than deferred to policy learning, and why instruction generation from quantized latents is an effective way to preserve language-recoverable structure. Finish with the SimplerEnv results and the codebook or token-semantic analyses.

A useful first pass should take about 35–50 minutes. The figures worth focusing on are the verb-information decomposition, mutual information versus compression, the main downstream success-rate table, and any visualization of token clusters or codebook organization. If your interest is unified multimodal pretraining, it is worth mentally replacing action tokens with image or audio tokens while reading; the same failure mode likely exists there as well, but action makes it easier to observe.

recommendation.zh: 动作侧tokenizer加语义对齐辅助loss的简洁案例，对统一模态离散化设计有参考；只看tokenizer loss设计和verb聚类图即可。
recommendation.en: Clean case study on adding a semantic auxiliary loss to an action tokenizer; skim the tokenizer objective and verb-code clustering figures for multimodal-tokenizer transferable ideas.

paper.title: Depth-Wise Probing and Pruning of the Planning Token in a Driving Vision-Language-Action Model
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models route driving decisions through a deep language model, but it is unclear how much of that depth the action itself requires. We study a representative driving VLA whose entire plan is carried by a single planning token that a generative planner decodes into a trajectory. Borrowing the planner as a trajectory-space logit lens, we decode the planning token from every one of the 32 decoder layers and measure two signals: the linear decodability of the navigation c

summary.core_problem: 分析驾驶 VLA 中单个 planning token 在 32 层语言解码器各深度上何时编码语义意图、何时变得可被轨迹规划器使用。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制分析而非新模型。它提供了一个关于 VLA 深度使用的细粒度观察：高层导航语义很早可线性读出，但与冻结轨迹 planner 的接口兼容性仍随深度逐步改善。这对理解 action token、logit lens 和模型剪枝有弱启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者借用原生 generative planner 作为 trajectory-space logit lens，从 32 个 decoder layer 的每一层解码 planning token。测量两个信号：导航命令的线性可解码性，以及该层 planning token 经冻结 native planner 解码出的轨迹与目标轨迹的兼容性。还训练 learned readout 检查早层表示是否已经包含可恢复的规划信息。
summary.experiments: 研究对象是一个代表性 driving VLA，整个计划由单个 planning token 承载，并由生成式 planner 解码成轨迹。命令 probe 在第 1 个 decoder layer 后达到 97.7% accuracy，而随机水平为 16.7%；open-loop Avg-L2 随深度改善，最终层达到最低 2.11 m。learned readout 可从第 1 层恢复相当一部分轨迹差距。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper probes a driving VLA to determine at which decoder depths a single planning token encodes semantic intent and when it becomes compatible with the trajectory planner.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism study rather than a new model. It gives a fine-grained observation about depth usage in VLA models: high-level navigation intent is linearly decodable very early, while compatibility with the frozen trajectory planner improves gradually through depth. This is mildly useful for thinking about action tokens, logit-lens-style probes, and pruning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use the native generative planner as a trajectory-space logit lens and decode the planning token from each of 32 decoder layers. They measure command linear decodability and trajectory compatibility with the frozen planner. Learned readouts are also trained to test whether early-layer representations already contain recoverable planning information.
summary_en.experiments: The studied driving VLA carries the whole plan in one planning token, decoded by a generative planner. Command-probe accuracy reaches 97.7% after the first decoder layer versus 16.7% chance. Open-loop Avg-L2 improves across depth and reaches its minimum, 2.11 m, at the final layer. Learned readouts from the first layer recover much of the remaining gap.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 数字和 probing 设计即可；它提醒别把“早层不可用”和“planner 接口没对齐”混为一谈。
recommendation.en: Read the probing setup and headline numbers; it usefully separates early representational availability from planner-interface compatibility.

paper.title: WAM-Diff2: Hierarchical AR-to-Diffusion Distillation for Highly Efficient Autonomous Driving VLA
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving; however, their efficient deployment is severely constrained by high computational latency and exposure bias arising from sequential autoregressive decoding. Conversely, while specialized diffusion policies enable low-latency, parallel execution, training them from scratch typically yields narrow, single-task architectures that lack holistic visual-linguistic reasoning. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决自动驾驶 VLA 中 AR 解码慢、长序列易受 exposure bias 影响的问题。目标不是从零训练一个窄任务 diffusion policy，而是把已有 AR driving generalist 转换成并行的离散 diffusion VLA，同时尽量保留其多任务视觉-语言-动作能力。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值在于 AR 到 diffusion 的架构迁移。虽然场景是自动驾驶，但问题具有一般性：如何把一个因果注意力、teacher forcing 训练出来的通用模型，迁移到双向上下文、并行 refinement 的生成范式。它提供了一个 staged distillation recipe，可作为 AR+diffusion 统一建模、动作 token 生成、低延迟多模态 LM 的参考。贡献量级偏工程方法，但抓住了一个真实难点：注意力模式和优化目标同时改变时，直接替换训练目标通常会损伤已有语义能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 WAM-Diff2，一个多任务离散 diffusion VLA，并使用三阶段层级蒸馏。第一阶段是 Progressive Block-Wise Adaptation，用 block-causal attention 逐步放松严格因果约束；通过 curriculum 扩大 decoding block，让模型从 AR 过渡到更并行的条件结构，避免一次性切到双向注意力导致训练不稳。第二阶段是 Block-Wise Distillation，让 student 接触并行解码过程中的中间 noisy states，并用 on-policy small-block diffusion teacher 对齐这些状态下的预测行为；这一步针对的是 AR teacher forcing 与 diffusion 迭代 refinement 之间的分布差异。第三阶段是 Model-Wise Cross-Scale Distillation，从 8B diffusion teacher 向 2B student 迁移。论文的观察是，同属 diffusion 范式的大小模型在 token prediction pattern 上更容易对齐，因此跨尺度蒸馏比直接从 AR 大模型压到 diffusion 小模型更稳定。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三类自动驾驶相关任务：轨迹规划使用 NAVSIM 和 Bench2Drive，驾驶视觉问答使用 DriveBench 和 LingoQA，视觉感知使用 COCO。论文声称 AR-to-diffusion 转换后，相对 AR foundation 保持或提升任务表现，同时带来 2.8× 解码加速；结合 FlashInfer、CUDA Graphs 等系统优化后，总加速达到 15.1×。从给出的内容看，关键实验应包括三阶段蒸馏的逐步消融、8B 到 2B 的跨尺度蒸馏效果、以及不同任务上性能与延迟的 trade-off。最需要核查的是加速数字的计量口径：是否只算动作 token 解码，是否包含视觉编码器和前处理，batch size 与硬件设置如何。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–45 分钟。优先看 Methodology 的 3.1–3.3：AR formulation、离散 diffusion formulation、三阶段蒸馏的训练目标和 attention mask。结果部分重点看 latency table、stage-wise ablation、teacher/student scale ablation。对预训练研究更有用的是 Stage I 和 Stage II：前者讨论如何平滑改变 attention pattern，后者处理从 teacher-forced AR 分布到 diffusion noisy-state 分布的错位。自动驾驶 benchmark 的细节可以略读，除非关注 VLA 部署。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the latency and exposure-bias limitations of autoregressive VLA models for autonomous driving. Instead of training a narrow diffusion policy from scratch, it tries to translate a pretrained AR driving generalist into a parallel discrete diffusion VLA while preserving its multi-task visual-language-action capability.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for foundation-model research is the AR-to-diffusion transition recipe. The domain is driving, but the modeling issue is broader: how to move a causal, teacher-forced model into a bidirectional iterative-refinement generator without losing the semantic and task knowledge stored in the pretrained model. The contribution is mainly a training and distillation pipeline, with relevance to unified AR+diffusion modeling, action-token generation, and low-latency multimodal language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: WAM-Diff2 is a multi-task discrete diffusion VLA trained through a three-stage hierarchical distillation process. Stage I, Progressive Block-Wise Adaptation, introduces block-causal attention and gradually relaxes strict causal decoding through a curriculum over decoding blocks. This avoids an abrupt switch from unidirectional AR attention to bidirectional refinement. Stage II, Block-Wise Distillation, exposes the student to intermediate noisy states produced during parallel decoding and uses an on-policy small-block diffusion teacher to align predictions under the diffusion process. This addresses the distribution mismatch between teacher-forced AR training and noisy-state refinement. Stage III, Model-Wise Cross-Scale Distillation, transfers knowledge from an 8B diffusion teacher to a compact 2B student. The paper reports that models sharing the diffusion paradigm have more aligned token prediction patterns, making cross-scale transfer easier than directly compressing an AR teacher into a diffusion student.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans trajectory planning on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive, driving-oriented VQA on DriveBench and LingoQA, and visual perception on COCO. The reported outcome is performance parity or improvement relative to the AR foundation, with a 2.8× decoding speedup from the AR-to-diffusion conversion. With system-level optimizations such as FlashInfer and CUDA Graphs, the reported acceleration reaches 15.1×. The key experiments to inspect are the stage-wise distillation ablations, the 8B-to-2B cross-scale distillation comparison, and the task-performance-versus-latency trade-off. The speedup numbers need careful reading: whether they include the vision encoder, preprocessing, batch size effects, and the exact hardware setup matters for interpreting deployment gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 30–45 minutes. Start with the method sections describing the AR objective, the discrete diffusion objective, the attention masks, and the three-stage distillation schedule. Then check the latency table, stage-wise ablations, and teacher/student scale ablations. For pretraining-oriented readers, Stage I and Stage II are the most relevant parts: they address how to change attention structure gradually and how to train on diffusion noisy states rather than AR teacher-forced prefixes. The driving benchmark details can be read lightly unless VLA deployment is the main interest.

recommendation.zh: AR到离散扩散的三阶段蒸馏设计很有参考性，做统一多模态建模范式的重点看蒸馏流程与注意力对齐部分。
recommendation.en: The three-stage AR-to-discrete-diffusion distillation design is informative; focus on the distillation pipeline and attention alignment if working on unified multimodal paradigms.

paper.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models commonly adopt an LLM-centric $V \to L \to A$ pathway, where visual observations are projected into the representation space of a large language model before being decoded into robot actions. Although effective, this design incurs substantial computation and memory overhead at every policy invocation. In this work, we introduce TurboVLA, a new VLA paradigm that reformulates the conventional $V \to L \to A$ pathway as a direct $V + L \to A$ mapping. Instead of

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 模型在每次机器人策略调用时依赖大语言模型中枢，导致算力、显存和延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLA 推理路径和轻量动作解码的系统设计，重点在实时部署效率；它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对 embodied 模型是否必须 LLM-centric 提供了一个反例。
summary.technical_approach: TurboVLA 将传统的 V→L→A 路径改为直接 V+L→A：视觉观测和语言指令分别编码，通过轻量双向视觉语言交互融合，再由紧凑 decoder 预测连续 action chunks，避免在高频控制环路中调用大 LLM 表征空间。
summary.experiments: 标题给出的核心结果是在 RTX 4090 上以 32 Hz 实时运行，显存占用低于 1 GB。摘要没有提供完整机器人任务、数据规模、baseline 名称或成功率提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the high compute, memory, and latency cost of using an LLM-centric interface at every policy invocation in vision-language-action models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an efficient VLA inference and action-decoding design. It does not directly advance LLM pretraining, but it is a useful counterexample to the assumption that embodied policies must be LLM-centric.
summary_en.technical_approach: TurboVLA replaces the conventional V→L→A pathway with a direct V+L→A mapping: visual observations and language instructions are encoded independently, fused through lightweight bidirectional vision-language interaction, and decoded into continuous action chunks.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is real-time execution at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with less than 1 GB VRAM. The supplied abstract does not include full task suites, data scale, named baselines, or success-rate deltas.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构图和 latency/VRAM 表；它提醒 VLA 不一定要把 LLM 放在控制回路中心。
recommendation.en: Read only the architecture and latency/VRAM tables; it is a useful reminder that VLA control loops need not be LLM-centered.

paper.title: CoTinyVLA: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for a Sub-Billion-Parameter Vision-Language-Action Model
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models translate natural-language commands into robot action sequences, but leading systems on the LIBERO-Plus robustness benchmark use three- to seven-billion-parameter backbones whose memory demands can exceed embedded robotic budgets. We present CoTinyVLA, a 0.9B-parameter action model on a Qwen3.5-0.8B backbone that obtains that robustness by structuring supervision instead of enlarging the model. Three components target different axes of the problem: dual-view t

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 机器人策略模型在鲁棒性和端侧部署之间的冲突：大模型效果好，但 3B-7B backbone 的内存成本过高。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLA 后训练与蒸馏方法。它对小模型如何吸收大模型的规划和动作分解信号有参考价值，但实验集中在机器人 LIBERO-Plus，不是通用多模态预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoTinyVLA，使用 Qwen3.5-0.8B 作为 0.9B 级动作模型 backbone。方法包括三部分：每步输入 16 帧双视角时序图像，并加入文本化相机和时间标记；从 35B teacher 蒸馏层级 CoT，包括 episode-level Plan 和 chunk-level Think；把 40 条基础命令改写扩展到 800 个变体。
summary.experiments: 在 LIBERO-Plus 的 10,030 个扰动任务上评估，覆盖 7 类扰动维度。摘要报告 Spatial 90.8%、Object 87.3%、Goal 86.6%、Long-horizon 80.7%。对比对象是使用 3B-7B backbone 的领先 VLA 系统，但摘要未给出完整 baseline 表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the deployment gap in VLA robot policies: large backbones are robust, but 3B-7B models are too memory-heavy for embedded robotic settings.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLA post-training and distillation contribution. It is relevant to small-model supervision design, but the evidence is robotics-specific rather than a general multimodal pretraining result.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoTinyVLA is a 0.9B action model built on a Qwen3.5-0.8B backbone. It combines dual-view temporal inputs with 16 history frames and textual camera/time markers, hierarchical CoT distillation from a 35B teacher into episode-level Plan and chunk-level Think spans, and paraphrase augmentation from 40 base commands to 800 variants.
summary_en.experiments: The model is evaluated on 10,030 perturbed LIBERO-Plus tasks across seven perturbation dimensions. The abstract reports 90.8% on Spatial, 87.3% on Object, 86.6% on Goal, and 80.7% on Long-horizon. It compares against leading VLA systems using 3B-7B backbones, though full baseline details are not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看 CoT 蒸馏格式和 LIBERO-Plus 表；它更像小 VLA recipe，不会改写多模态预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the CoT distillation format and the LIBERO-Plus table; this is a compact VLA recipe, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: SAM3D-Guided Object-Centric Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general robot manipulation, but most existing models rely on 2D visual-language backbones and lack fine-grained 3D understanding of target objects, especially under occlusion, pose variation, scale changes, and precise spatial interaction. We propose an object-centric 3D representation alignment framework built upon $π_0$, using SAM3D as a frozen 3D teacher to provide target-object 3D priors during training. Specifically, we loc

summary.core_problem: 提升 Vision-Language-Action 模型在机器人操作中对目标物体 3D 结构的理解，尤其是在遮挡、姿态变化、尺度变化和精细空间交互场景下。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLA 训练中的表示对齐方法：用冻结 3D teacher 在训练期注入物体级 3D 先验，同时保持测试期仍是 RGB-language-to-action pipeline。它对多模态表示蒸馏有参考价值，但更偏机器人策略训练，不是通用 VLM 预训练工作。
summary.technical_approach: 方法建立在 π_0 上，先用物体识别模型定位任务相关物体并生成 mask，再调用冻结的 SAM3D 提取 dense object-level 3D representation。训练时将这些 3D 表示与 π_0 的中间视觉特征对齐，使 policy 内化目标物体 3D 信息；推理时不需要 depth、point cloud、mask、SAM3D 或额外 3D 模块。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在仿真实验中取得一致改进，主要评估对象是机器人操作任务中的 VLA policy。提供的摘要未给出任务数量、训练数据规模、π_0 参数规模、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve object-centric 3D understanding in Vision-Language-Action models for robotic manipulation, especially under occlusion, pose variation, scale changes, and precise spatial interaction.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a representation-alignment method for VLA training: a frozen 3D teacher injects object-level 3D priors during training while preserving the RGB-language-to-action inference pipeline. It is relevant to multimodal distillation, but it is closer to robotics policy training than general VLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on π_0, the method localizes task-relevant objects with recognition models, generates masks, and uses frozen SAM3D to extract dense object-level 3D representations. These representations are aligned to intermediate visual features of π_0 during training so that the policy internalizes 3D object information. At inference time, no depth, point clouds, masks, SAM3D, or extra 3D modules are required.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports consistent improvements in simulation experiments for robotic manipulation. The provided snippet does not include task counts, data scale, π_0 size, baseline details, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 3D teacher 蒸馏到 VLA 是合理工程，不改变 VLM 预训练 prior；扫方法图和消融即可。
recommendation.en: Distilling a 3D teacher into a VLA policy is sensible engineering, but it does not change VLM pretraining priors; skim the method and ablations.

paper.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-1: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with over 100K Hours of Real-World Trajectories
paper.abstract: We present Xiaomi-Robotics-1, a foundational vision-language-action (VLA) model capable of (1) following diverse language instructions to perform a wide range of mobile manipulation tasks in unseen environments out-of-the-box, and (2) efficiently adapting to novel downstream tasks with minimal fine-tuning data. We propose a two-stage training recipe consisting of pre-training and post-training. During pre-training, we imbue the model with broad and generalizable action-generation capabilities by

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 VLA 机器人模型的数据规模问题：真实机器人遥操作数据昂贵、任务窄、环境重复，难以像 LLM 和 VLM 一样通过大规模预训练获得泛化能力。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练研究的直接相关性有限，但对“跨模态行为模型如何做大规模预训练”有启发。它把非机器人 UMI 轨迹、自动语言标注、跨 embodiment 对齐组织成两阶段 recipe，类似于先学通用 action-generation prior，再用高质量机器人数据做 post-training alignment。这个思路和基座模型中的 pretrain-posttrain 接口相近，尤其值得关注其数据标注和 scaling 实验。
summary.technical_approach: 模型是端到端 vision-language-action policy，输入视觉观察和语言指令，输出 action chunk。训练分两阶段。预训练阶段使用超过 100k 小时真实世界 manipulation trajectories，主要来自 UMI 设备。由于人工切分和标注在这个规模下成本过高，作者使用预训练 VLM 自动给固定长度轨迹片段生成自然语言描述，描述的是场景状态变化，而不是传统的命令式任务标签。模型因此学习“从当前状态到语言指定目标状态”的动作生成能力。post-training 阶段使用超过 10k 小时 cross-embodiment 数据，把 UMI gripper 的动作 prior 对齐到真实机器人 embodiment，并把 state-transition prompt 对齐到人类常用的 imperative instruction。架构上采用 Mixture-of-Transformers，并以 Qwen3-VL 作为视觉语言 backbone 的一部分。
summary.experiments: 实验显示预训练阶段存在清晰 scaling 行为：数据和模型规模增加时，validation action error 下降。更重要的是，这种预训练阶段的优势会传递到 post-training 后的真实机器人成功率。少样本适配实验中，在四个复杂 dexterous tasks 上，每个任务平均少于 10 小时数据，Xiaomi-Robotics-1 平均成功率为 75%，对比 π0.5 的 40%。仿真评测覆盖 RoboCasa、RoboCasa365、VLABench 和 RoboDojo。RoboCasa365 成功率为 57.6%，高于此前 46.6%；RoboDojo 平均分 20.07，高于此前 13.07。论文还展示了超过 10 分钟的房间级长程 suitcase packing 任务。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看数据构造和训练 recipe，而不是机器人 benchmark 排名。优先阅读 introduction 中对数据瓶颈的定义、Xiaomi-Robotics-1 章节中的两阶段训练、自动标注流程，以及 scaling 实验。对预训练研究更有用的问题是：自动生成的 state-transition captions 是否足够稳定；UMI 数据学到的 action prior 如何迁移到机器人 embodiment；validation action error 和真实任务成功率之间相关性有多强。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the data-scaling bottleneck for vision-language-action robotics models: real-robot teleoperation is expensive, hardware-bound, and often narrow in task and environment diversity.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited, but it is useful as a case study in large-scale multimodal action pretraining. The paper separates broad action-prior learning from embodiment and instruction alignment, which resembles the pretraining-to-posttraining interface used in foundation models. The most relevant parts are the trajectory auto-labeling pipeline, the use of state-transition language as supervision, and the scaling experiments showing that better pretraining transfers to better post-training performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Xiaomi-Robotics-1 is an end-to-end VLA policy that maps visual observations and language prompts to action chunks. Training has two stages. In pretraining, the model uses more than 100k hours of real-world manipulation trajectories collected with UMI devices. Since manual segmentation and annotation would not scale, the authors use a pretrained VLM to label fixed-length trajectory clips with natural-language descriptions of scene state transitions. This changes the supervision format from imperative task labels to descriptions of how the scene changes. The model learns to generate actions that move the scene from the current state toward the language-specified target state. In post-training, more than 10k hours of cross-embodiment robot data are used to align the UMI-derived action prior to robot embodiments and to convert state-transition prompting into human-style instructions. The model uses a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and incorporates Qwen3-VL as part of its vision-language backbone.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports scaling behavior during pretraining: larger models and more data reduce validation action error. This pretraining advantage transfers to post-training, where stronger pretrained models achieve higher real-robot success rates in unseen environments. In low-data adaptation, Xiaomi-Robotics-1 reaches an average success rate of 75% across four complex dexterous tasks with less than 10 hours of data per task on average, compared with 40% for π0.5. The model is also evaluated on RoboCasa, RoboCasa365, VLABench, and RoboDojo. It reports 57.6% success on RoboCasa365 compared with a previous 46.6%, and an average RoboDojo score of 20.07 compared with 13.07. The paper also demonstrates a long-horizon room-level suitcase-packing task lasting more than 10 minutes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on the data pipeline and training recipe rather than the robotics leaderboard numbers. The most useful parts are the motivation around robotics data scaling, the two-stage pretraining/post-training design, the VLM-based trajectory annotation pipeline, and the scaling plots connecting validation action error to downstream success. For pretraining researchers, the key questions are whether state-transition captions provide a stable training signal, how well a UMI-derived action prior transfers across embodiments, and how predictive offline action error is of real-world task success.

recommendation.zh: 重点看自动标注流水线与两阶段训练recipe，具身多模态预训练的数据配比和监督形式可直接迁移到内部VLM实验。
recommendation.en: Focus on the auto-labeling pipeline and two-stage training recipe; the data mixture and supervision design for embodied VLA pretraining are directly transferable to internal VLM ablations.

paper.title: JoyNexus: Service-Oriented Multi-Tenant Post-Training for VLA Models
paper.abstract: The post-training of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is essential due to the diversity of simulators, robot embodiments, and task objectives. Existing compute services, whether offered as direct accelerator rental or batch-workload submission, typically allocate an exclusive set of GPU and CPU resources to a single tenant. While this paradigm maximizes client flexibility, it burdens users with infrastructure adaptation, and the fixed card-hour accounting model renders short or bursty workloa

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 模型后训练中多租户、短任务、突发任务在算力服务上成本高、资源利用率低、环境适配重的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统工程：把 VLA 的 SFT、RL rollout 和评测做成统一服务，关注多租户共享、常驻模型和环境服务解耦；对通用 LLM 预训练方法论的直接增益有限，但对大规模后训练平台设计有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 JoyNexus，将 Training Model Service、Inference Model Service 和 Environment Service 解耦，通过 API 暴露训练、rollout、评测等高层语义接口；底层使用常驻共享 base model，并为不同租户保留 tenant-specific slots，避免每个任务独占完整 GPU/CPU 资源。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、租户数量、吞吐、排队延迟或成本节省数字；能确认的是系统覆盖 VLA supervised fine-tuning、reinforcement learning 和 evaluation 三类工作负载。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses inefficient and expensive infrastructure for multi-tenant, bursty post-training workloads of Vision-Language-Action models.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems contribution: it packages VLA SFT, RL rollout, and evaluation into a shared service. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but it may inform post-training platform design.
summary_en.technical_approach: JoyNexus decouples the Training Model Service, Inference Model Service, and Environment Service behind high-level APIs. It uses resident shared base models plus tenant-specific slots, instead of allocating exclusive accelerator and CPU resources to each tenant.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete model sizes, tenant counts, throughput, latency, or cost-reduction numbers. It states support for VLA supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and evaluation workloads.

recommendation.zh: 偏后训练平台工程，扫架构图即可；若没有利用率和隔离数据，不足以改变训练服务设计。
recommendation.en: Mostly post-training platform engineering; skim the architecture, and ignore strong claims unless utilization and isolation numbers are shown.

paper.title: See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict robot actions from visual observations and language instructions. These actions are defined in the robot's own 3D coordinate frame, yet most VLAs observe the scene in the camera frame, creating a frame mismatch between where the scene is observed and where actions are defined. The mismatch is benign under a fixed viewpoint, where the policy can memorize a single observation-to-action mapping, but grows harder as large-scale datasets aggregate demonstra

summary.core_problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的观测在相机坐标系、动作在机器人坐标系，跨视角泛化时存在帧不匹配问题，限制大规模多数据集训练后的泛化能力。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出机器人中心的pointmap输入表示，在最小架构改动下适配现有预训练2D VLA，提升跨视角泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 构造像素存储机器人帧下3D坐标的pointmap，既提供机器人坐标系的3D几何信息，又保留预训练VLA所需的密集HxW网格结构，可直接集成到现有VLA架构中。
summary.experiments: 在RoboCasa基准上，pointmap可提升pi0.5和SmolVLA的表现，优于代表性基线方法（摘要未完整披露具体提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models observe scenes in the camera frame but predict actions in the robot's coordinate frame, causing a frame mismatch that degrades generalization across diverse camera setups when training on large-scale multi-dataset demonstrations.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a robot-centric pointmap input representation that adapts to existing pretrained 2D VLAs with minimal architectural changes, improving cross-viewpoint generalization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs pointmaps where each pixel stores the 3D coordinate of the corresponding scene point in the robot frame, providing robot-frame 3D geometry while preserving the dense HxW grid structure required by pretrained VLAs, enabling direct integration into existing VLA architectures.
summary_en.experiments: On the RoboCasa benchmark, pointmaps improve performance of both pi0.5 and SmolVLA, outperforming representative baseline methods (specific improvement margins are not fully disclosed in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: VLA输入表示的工程改进，仅针对机器人具身场景，对通用多模态预训练无直接启发，了解即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering improvement of VLA input representation for robot embodied scenarios, no direct insight for general multimodal pretraining, good to know.

paper.title: Prompt-Driven Exploration
paper.abstract: Exploration is essential to RL since a policy cannot improve by repeatedly sampling the behaviors it already prefers. Standard methods inject stochasticity in the action space, but such jitter only yields rollouts close to the original. Escaping a weak policy often requires global perturbations that action noise cannot produce. Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a pathway: they condition the policy on a natural language prompt, and since the rollout follow

summary.core_problem: 解决弱策略在稀疏奖励环境中难以探索的问题：传统动作噪声只能产生局部扰动，无法让 VLA/LLM 条件策略跳出已有行为模式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent/RL 探索方法创新。它把自然语言 prompt 当作全局行为扰动变量，用 VLM 从 rollout 视频中诊断失败并改写 prompt，连接了语言条件策略和经典 posterior sampling 探索框架。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不是在动作空间加噪声，而是在 prompt 空间迭代搜索。系统观察一次 rollout 视频，用 VLM 判断策略如何响应当前 prompt、失败在哪里，再生成新的 prompt 来诱导下一轮更有用的行为变化。核心技术点是把 rollout 反思转化为 prompt posterior update。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务数量、模型规模、训练数据或提升幅度。可确认的是实验面向弱策略、稀疏奖励、LLM/VLA 条件控制场景，主要比较对象应是标准动作噪声式探索或固定 prompt 策略。
summary.authors_note: Pulkit Agrawal 代表性工作集中在机器人学习、强化学习和具身智能；该论文更接近 embodied agent/RL，而不是 LLM 预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses exploration for weak policies under sparse rewards, where action-space noise only produces local perturbations and fails to escape entrenched behaviors.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent/RL exploration contribution. It treats natural-language prompts as global behavioral perturbations for LLM/VLA-conditioned policies and connects prompt refinement from rollouts to posterior sampling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of injecting noise into actions, the method iterates in prompt space. A VLM inspects rollout videos, diagnoses how the policy reacted to the current prompt, and rewrites the prompt to elicit more useful behavior in the next trial.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete task counts, model sizes, training data, or numeric gains. The setup targets weak policies, sparse rewards, and LLM/VLA-conditioned control, likely against action-noise exploration and fixed-prompt baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Pulkit Agrawal is known for robotics, reinforcement learning, and embodied intelligence; this work is closer to embodied agent/RL than to LLM pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线；只看 prompt-space exploration 的设定，作为 RL 后训练里“语言变量当全局扰动”的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the prompt-space exploration setup as a weak signal for using language variables as global perturbations in RL.

paper.title: Pelican-VLA 0.5: Attending Before Acting Benefits Generalization
paper.abstract: In this report, we present Pelican-VLA 0.5, a unified VLA model that integrates vision-language understanding, future-frame generation, and action prediction within a single architecture. Pelican-VLA 0.5 achieves attention-level generalization: without object annotations, segmentation masks, attention supervision, or task-specific fine-tuning, its action pathway already focuses on the instruction-relevant object and contact region. This behavior persists across unseen scenes and unseen robot emb

summary.core_problem: 现有VLA模型的动作生成通路注意力通常弥散分布在机械臂、背景和无关物体上，依赖环境特定的视觉捷径，跨物体、场景、任务、机器人本体的零样本泛化能力差；目前尚不清楚是否能在预训练阶段就让模型形成面向操纵任务的稳定注意力模式，而非等到任务特定微调阶段才学习关注什么。
summary.importance: 提出的瓶颈token设计对多模态统一预训练的通路接口设计有普适参考价值：证明在感知模块和下游生成通路之间插入紧凑的可学习瓶颈token，可以在没有显式注意力监督、物体标注、分割掩码的条件下，让模型在预训练阶段自发形成任务相关的注意力路由；且微调过程基本不改变预训练形成的注意力模式，仅学习从注意区域到输出的映射，这一观察对VLM、统一多模态模型的跨任务接口设计同样适用。
summary.technical_approach: 构建单Transformer主干的统一VLA模型，预训练同时覆盖三个目标：视觉语言理解、未来帧生成、动作预测。核心设计是在视觉-语言感知模块和动作生成通路之间插入少量可学习的Bottleneck Tokens：这些token通过全注意力查询上游的视觉-语言上下文，将操纵相关信息压缩到紧凑的瓶颈表示中，再传递给下游动作通路；动作通路不被允许直接访问全部稠密视觉token。这种受限的信息路由迫使模型在预训练阶段主动筛选操纵相关的视觉信息（目标物体、接触区域、预期状态变化、机器人自身状态约束），减少对低层视觉细节和环境捷径的依赖。
summary.experiments: 1）零样本设置下（未见过的场景、物体、机器人本体），模型的动作通路注意力显著集中在操纵目标和接触区域，对齐效果远强于其他开源VLA基线，全程无额外注意力监督；2）训练完成后移除Bottleneck Tokens，模型仍保留部分操纵导向的注意力能力，说明这种注意模式已经内化到共享主干表示中，而非仅由瓶颈token的路由作用产生；3）在RoboTwin仿真基准微调后，Clean场景成功率91.4%，Randomized场景91.0%，为开源VLA中的最优平均表现；4）微调前后注意力模式高度相似，说明微调并未重新学习注意偏好，仅负责将预训练形成的注意模式映射到可执行动作；5）零样本跨场景、跨物体、跨本体设置下可取得非零任务成功率，多数基线在此设置下完全无法完成任务，但模型仍存在明显的注意力到动作执行的落地缺口。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言中对现有VLA注意力弥散问题的观察、Bottleneck Tokens的设计逻辑、微调前后注意力模式对比的可视化与对应结论，无需纠结机器人动作生成的具体实现细节和RoboTwin基准的全任务列表，核心可迁移的启发是“预训练阶段通过瓶颈接口诱导任务相关注意力路由”的通用思路，无需局限于机器人场景，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Vision-Language-Action models typically produce diffuse attention in their action pathways, spreading weight across robot arms, background clutter, and task-irrelevant objects. These models rely on environment-specific visual shortcuts, leading to poor zero-shot generalization across unseen objects, scenes, tasks, and robot embodiments. It remains an open question whether models can form stable, task-aligned attention patterns during pretraining, rather than learning what to attend to only during task-specific fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: The proposed bottleneck token design has transferable implications for general multimodal foundation model pretraining: inserting a compact set of learnable bottleneck tokens between the perceptual encoder and downstream generation pathway can induce task-relevant attention routing during pretraining, without explicit attention supervision, object annotations, or segmentation masks. The observation that fine-tuning largely preserves pretrained attention patterns, and only learns the mapping from these preformed attention regions to outputs, is relevant to interface design for general VLMs and unified multimodal models, not just robotic systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pelican-VLA 0.5 uses a single Transformer backbone jointly trained on three objectives: vision-language understanding, future frame generation, and action prediction. The key design is a small set of learnable Bottleneck Tokens inserted between the vision-language perception stack and the action generation pathway. These tokens query upstream vision-language context via full attention, compress manipulation-relevant information into a compact bottleneck representation, and pass this representation to the action pathway; the action pathway has no direct access to the full set of dense visual tokens. This constrained routing forces the model to actively select manipulation-relevant visual information (target objects, contact regions, intended future state changes, robot state constraints) during pretraining, reducing reliance on low-level visual details and environment-specific shortcuts.
summary_en.experiments: (1) In zero-shot settings (unseen scenes, objects, robot embodiments), the action pathway shows significantly more focused attention on manipulation targets and contact regions than open-source VLA baselines, with no explicit attention supervision. (2) Removing Bottleneck Tokens after training does not fully eliminate manipulation-aligned attention, indicating the learned attention pattern is internalized into the shared backbone representation, rather than being purely a function of the bottleneck routing itself. (3) After fine-tuning on the RoboTwin simulation benchmark, the model achieves 91.4% success on clean scenes and 91.0% on randomized scenes, the top average performance among open-source VLA baselines. (4) Attention patterns are nearly identical before and after fine-tuning, indicating fine-tuning does not re-learn attention preferences, but only maps pre-formed attention patterns to executable actions. (5) The model achieves non-zero success rates on zero-shot cross-scene, cross-object, cross-embodiment tasks where most baselines fail completely, though a clear gap remains between aligned attention and reliable action execution.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the introductory observation of diffuse attention in existing VLAs, the design rationale for Bottleneck Tokens, and the comparison of attention patterns before and after fine-tuning. Skip granular details of robot action generation implementations and the full RoboTwin task list. The most transferable insight is the general approach of using bottleneck interfaces during pretraining to induce task-relevant attention routing, which applies beyond robotic use cases. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 slots 设计和注意力可视化即可；若 setup 干净，它会影响 VLA 预训练里 bottleneck 接口的取舍。
recommendation.en: Read the slot design and attention visualizations; if the setup is clean, it is a useful data point for bottleneck interfaces in VLA pretraining.

paper.title: Dual Latent Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
paper.abstract: Mainstream Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predict actions primarily from the current observation under a Markovian assumption, thus struggling with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks. Existing memory-augmented VLAs either expand the observation window or retrieve history from the memory bank as auxiliary policy-side context. However, they leave memory outside the native latent embedding space of VLA reasoning, preventing historical experience from being fluidly interleaved with multim

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 模型在长程机器人操作中只依赖当前观测、难以利用历史经验的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLA 体系中的记忆机制改进：把历史经验重构为原生 latent memory tokens，并放入多模态推理和动作生成链路中，而不是只作为外部检索上下文。对通用多模态 agent 和 embodied LM 有一定参考，但离 LLM 基座预训练主线较远。
summary.technical_approach: LaMem-VLA 包含四个组件：curator 将历史经验组织成短期和长期两个 memory vault；seeker 根据当前多模态认知状态查询记忆；后续模块把检索到的历史经验重构为 latent memory tokens，并与 VLA 的视觉、语言、动作推理过程交织。方法是对现有 VLA 策略加入内生化记忆表征。
summary.experiments: 摘要片段未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、机器人任务集、baseline 和定量结果。可确认的实验目标应是长程、时间依赖的机器人操作任务，并与当前观测式 VLA、窗口扩展式记忆或外部检索式记忆进行比较。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Shuicheng Yan，他长期从事计算机视觉、多模态学习和机器人相关研究。仅凭摘要无法确认完整机构信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the inability of Markovian VLA policies to use historical experience effectively in long-horizon robotic manipulation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a memory mechanism for VLA models: historical experience is reconstructed into native latent memory tokens and interleaved with multimodal reasoning and action formation, rather than being used only as external retrieved context. It is relevant to embodied multimodal agents, but not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: LaMem-VLA introduces a curator that organizes experience into short-term and long-term memory vaults, a seeker that queries them using the current multimodal cognitive state, and downstream components that reconstruct retrieved experience into latent memory tokens for direct interaction with VLA reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract fragment does not specify model size, training data, robotic benchmarks, baselines, or quantitative gains. The intended comparison is likely against current-observation VLA policies, enlarged observation windows, and external memory retrieval methods.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Shuicheng Yan, known for work in computer vision, multimodal learning, and robotics. Full affiliations cannot be verified from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 只看 latent memory token 的设计即可；机器人实验若不够大，结论更像 VLA 工程经验而非基座规律。
recommendation.en: Skim the latent-memory-token design only; unless the robotics setup is large and clean, treat the results as VLA engineering signal, not foundation-model law.

paper.title: Cortex: A Bidirectionally Aligned Embodied Agent Framework for Long-horizon Manipulation
paper.abstract: While recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise toward generalist manipulation policies, they struggle with long-horizon tasks due to their Markovian nature-relying solely on current observations. Hierarchical dual-system methods address this but suffer from a gap between high-level planning semantics and low-level execution kinematics. We introduce Cortex, a bidirectionally aligned embodied agent framework with a customized planning interface that conveys executable and tractable

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 操作模型在长程机器人任务中只依赖当前观测、缺少可执行长期计划的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 embodied agent 方法和数据管线：试图把高层 VLM 规划语义与低层 VLA 运动执行对齐，并用标准化技能原语降低长程操作的标注和执行难度。
summary.technical_approach: Cortex 设计双向对齐的 embodied agent 框架。高层 VLM 通过定制 planning interface 输出可执行、可追踪的子任务计划；低层 VLA 执行这些计划。作者将操作子任务标准化为 32 个 canonical skill primitives，并在数据生成中加入代表性物体属性、轨迹可达性等 tractability principles；还使用 event-balanced sampling 构造训练数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要称自动标注超过 4k 小时开源视频，并生成 30 小时仿真数据，用于训练或微调长程操作系统；未给出具体 VLM/VLA 模型规模、仿真环境、真实机器人设置、baseline 或成功率提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the weakness of VLA manipulation models on long-horizon tasks, where policies often depend only on current observations and lack executable long-term plans.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an embodied-agent framework and data pipeline. It tries to align high-level VLM planning semantics with low-level VLA kinematic execution using standardized skill primitives.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cortex introduces a bidirectionally aligned embodied-agent framework. A high-level VLM emits executable and tractable subtask plans through a customized planning interface, while a low-level VLA executes them. Manipulation subtasks are standardized into 32 canonical skill primitives, and the data-generation process injects tractability principles such as representative object attributes and improved trajectory reachability. Event-balanced sampling is used to construct fine-tuning data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports automatic annotation of more than 4k hours of open-source video and generation of 30 hours of simulation data. It does not specify the VLM/VLA sizes, environments, real-robot setup, baselines, or success-rate improvements.

recommendation.zh: 读数据接口和 skill primitive 设计即可；它更像 embodied SFT 管线，不会改变 LM 预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Read the data interface and skill-primitive design only; this is closer to an embodied SFT pipeline than a pretraining result.

paper.title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
paper.abstract: Embodied AI models now span vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs), but practical deployment remains fragmented across model-specific Python stacks, backend assumptions, and robot-side glue code, especially on heterogeneous edge devices. Existing inference runtimes are designed mainly for request-response serving and therefore do not satisfy the runtime contract of embodied deployment: multi-rate execution inside closed-loop control, latency-first batch-1 inference on

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 和 world-action embodied models 在异构机器人上部署时，被模型专用 Python 栈、后端假设和机器人胶水代码割裂的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理运行时和系统工程。它指出 embodied deployment 与常规 request-response serving 不同：需要闭环控制中的多速率执行、batch-1 低延迟推理，以及超出固定 token I/O 的机器人接口。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Embodied.cpp，一个面向具身模型的可移植 C++ 推理运行时。系统将代表性 VLA 和 WAM 的执行路径抽象为五层：input adapters、sequence builders、backbone execution、head plugins、deployment adapters，并提供模块化多速率执行、低延迟融合推理和可扩展部署接口。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体机器人平台数量、模型规模、延迟、吞吐、内存或对比基线。论文重点似乎是架构分析和运行时设计，而不是新的模型训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles deployment fragmentation for VLA and world-action embodied models across heterogeneous robots, where model-specific Python stacks and robot-side glue code dominate.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference runtime and systems abstraction. It highlights that embodied deployment differs from request-response serving: it needs multi-rate closed-loop execution, latency-first batch-1 inference, and embodied interfaces beyond fixed token I/O.
summary_en.technical_approach: Embodied.cpp is a portable C++ runtime for embodied models. It abstracts common execution into five layers: input adapters, sequence builders, backbone execution, head plugins, and deployment adapters. It supports modular multi-rate execution, latency-oriented fused inference, and extensible robot deployment interfaces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not give model sizes, latency numbers, memory usage, robot counts, or quantitative baselines. The apparent emphasis is runtime architecture and deployment design rather than model training.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统分层即可；它提醒 VLA serving 的接口假设不同于 LLM，但没有预训练方法论增量。
recommendation.en: Only skim the runtime layering; it usefully exposes how VLA serving differs from LLM serving, but it does not move pretraining methodology.

paper.title: The Moving Eye: Enhancing VLA Spatial Generalization via Hybrid Dynamic Data Collection
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable promise in generalized robotic manipulation. However, their spatial generalization remains fragile. We argue that simply increasing the number of viewpoints is insufficient. Models often fall into the trap of Shortcut Learning, latching onto spurious correlations (e.g., fixed relative poses between objects or between the camera and robot base) rather than learning true spatial relationships. In this work, we propose a data-centric solutio

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操纵中空间泛化能力弱、易学习相机-基座固定位姿等虚假相关性的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新+数据贡献，系统对比三种视角数据分布对空间泛化的影响，提出混合动态-静态视角的数据收集范式，为减少多模态模型空间shortcut learning提供实验依据。
summary.technical_approach: 采用双臂实验平台，一臂执行操纵任务，另一臂作为移动环境相机；设计固定视角、多固定视角、移动视角三种数据分布，最终提出混合连续相机运动与多样静态视角的策略，在减少虚假相关性的同时保持训练稳定性。
summary.experiments: 在双臂机器人操纵场景下验证，对比三种数据分布模式，混合策略在空间泛化任务上表现最优，显著降低模型对虚假空间相关性的依赖；具体模型参数量、训练数据量摘要未明确给出。
summary.authors_note: 摘要未提及作者机构及知名作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses weak spatial generalization of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in robotic manipulation, where models learn spurious correlations like fixed camera-base poses instead of true spatial relationships.
summary_en.importance: Methodological and data contribution; systematically compares the impact of three view data distributions on spatial generalization, proposes a hybrid dynamic-static view data collection paradigm, and provides experimental evidence for reducing spatial shortcut learning in multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses a dual-arm setup with one arm performing manipulation and the other as a mobile environmental camera; designs three data distribution patterns (Fixed, Multi-Fixed, Moving Views) and proposes a hybrid strategy combining continuous camera motion with diverse static viewpoints to reduce spurious correlations while maintaining training stability.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on a dual-arm robotic manipulation scenario; the hybrid strategy achieves the best spatial generalization and significantly reduces reliance on spurious spatial correlations; specific model parameters and data volume are not specified in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations and notable authors are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 仅作多模态数据设计的弱参考，核心结论限于机器人VLA场景，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Weak reference for multimodal data design; conclusions are limited to robotic VLA scenarios, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic pretraining for VLAs
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are fundamentally bottlenecked by the scarcity of expert demonstrations -- triplets of observations, instructions, and actions that are costly to collect at scale. We argue that this bottleneck stems from conflating two distinct learning objectives: acquiring physical competence (how to move) and acquiring semantic alignment (what to do). Crucially, only the latter requires language supervision. Building on this Decomposition Hypothesis, we propose Task-Agnost

summary.core_problem: 如何缓解视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型对昂贵专家演示数据的严重依赖？
summary.importance: 提出“分解假设”，将物理能力（如何移动）和语义对齐（做什么）解耦，通过无监督预训练大幅减少对标注数据的需求。
summary.technical_approach: 提出任务无关预训练（TAP）两阶段框架。第一阶段通过自监督逆动力学目标，从廉价的无标注交互数据（如废弃轨迹、自主探索）中学习可迁移的运动先验。第二阶段使用少量专家数据将这些先验与语言对齐。
summary.experiments: 在 SIMPLER 基准测试上，TAP 使用少几个数量级的标注数据，匹配了在超过 100 万条专家轨迹上训练的模型，并带来 10% 的绝对提升。
summary.authors_note: 复旦大学邱锡鹏团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to alleviate the severe reliance of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on expensive expert demonstration data?
summary_en.importance: Proposes the 'Decomposition Hypothesis', decoupling physical competence (how to move) from semantic alignment (what to do), drastically reducing the need for labeled data via unsupervised pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Task-Agnostic Pretraining (TAP), a two-stage framework. Stage 1 learns transferable motor priors from cheap, unlabeled interaction data via a self-supervised Inverse Dynamics objective. Stage 2 grounds these priors in language using minimal expert data.
summary_en.experiments: On the SIMPLER benchmark, TAP matches models trained on over 1M expert trajectories while using orders of magnitude less labeled data, yielding a 10% absolute improvement.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Xipeng Qiu's team at Fudan University.

recommendation.zh: VLA 领域的预训练范式改进，将动作先验学习与语言对齐解耦，对多模态具身智能预训练有参考价值，但对纯文本 LLM 启发有限。
recommendation.en: Pretraining paradigm improvement in VLA, decoupling motor prior learning from language alignment; valuable for multimodal embodied AI pretraining, but limited inspiration for pure text LLMs.

paper.title: Reasoning-aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
paper.abstract: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) planners for autonomous driving emit a chain-of-causation (CoC) reasoning step \emph{before} producing a trajectory. The reasoning is autoregressive and dominates inference latency, while the trajectory head is parallel and cheap. Latency is an operational constraint in autonomous driving, so accelerating the reasoning step is the central problem we address. We observe that CoC reasoning has two qualitatively different needs: most tokens continue routine setup

summary.core_problem: 降低自动驾驶 VLA planner 中链式因果推理文本的自回归解码延迟，因为轨迹头可并行且开销较小，瓶颈主要在 reasoning tokens。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 VLA 推理链的推测解码变体：把常规延续和需要新视觉证据的关键承诺区分处理。它与高效推理相关，但场景强绑定自动驾驶，不是通用 LLM serving 或预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 方法将 CoC reasoning 拆为两条路径：routine reasoner 根据历史 ego-trajectory 生成可预测的常规 token；deliberative reasoner 保留原始 VLA target，处理需要当前视觉证据的新情况。整体使用 speculative decoding 框架，让轻量路径提出 draft，再由目标模型校验或接管。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体 VLA 模型、参数量、数据集、接受率、速度提升或轨迹质量指标。可确认的实验关注自动驾驶 VLA planner 的 reasoning latency，而非通用文本模型解码。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce autoregressive reasoning latency in autonomous-driving VLA planners, where the reasoning chain is expensive while trajectory generation is relatively cheap.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a speculative-decoding variant for VLA chain-of-causation reasoning. It separates routine continuation from visually grounded commitments, but the setting is tightly tied to autonomous driving rather than general LLM serving or pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method introduces two paths: a routine reasoner drafts predictable continuation from ego-trajectory history, while the unchanged deliberative VLA target handles novel cases requiring current visual evidence. The design is placed inside a speculative decoding framework.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report VLA model size, datasets, acceptance rates, latency gains, or trajectory-quality metrics. The evaluation is framed around reasoning latency in autonomous-driving VLA planners.

recommendation.zh: 可看抽象的 token 分工假设；若无接受率和错误案例，别把它外推到通用 LLM 解码。
recommendation.en: Read the token-partitioning hypothesis; without acceptance rates and failure cases, do not extrapolate to general LLM decoding.

paper.title: MIRTH: Mutual-Information Reasoning with Temporal Hubs for Vision-Language-Action Agents
paper.abstract: VLA models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring semantic knowledge from web-scale data to physical robotic control. However, current single-frame architectures suffer from intrinsic limitations: temporal myopia that discards historical dynamics, reasoning gaps between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and inference inefficiency due to autoregressive scalar decoding. In this work, we propose MIRTH, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. MIRTH

summary.core_problem: 当前单帧 VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型存在时间近视、高层指令与低层动作推理断层、自回归解码推理慢三大局限。
summary.importance: 方法创新，在预训练 VLA 骨架上提出三方面改进：时序记忆压缩、互信息潜变量规划、并行动作解码，面向机器人控制场景。
summary.technical_approach: 1) 双尺度时序 hub 压缩长期场景演化与短期运动趋势为紧凑嵌入；2) 通过互信息目标优化潜推理 token，对齐多模态上下文与动作轨迹的语义规划空间；3) 用向量级并行预测替代自回归标量解码以提升控制吞吐。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量、训练数据规模与量化提升幅度，仅说明在多个机器人控制任务上做了广泛实验验证。
summary.authors_note: 无法从摘要确认机构与作者背景，返回空字符串。

summary_en.core_problem: Current single-frame Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models suffer from temporal myopia, a reasoning gap between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and slow autoregressive decoding.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation on top of a pretrained VLA backbone, introducing three targeted improvements for robotic control: temporal memory compression, mutual-information latent planning, and parallel action decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Dual-scale temporal hubs that compress long-term scene evolution and short-term motion trends into compact embeddings; 2) latent reasoning tokens optimized via a mutual-information objective to align multimodal context with action trajectories in a semantic plan space; 3) vector-wise parallel action prediction replacing autoregressive scalar decoding for higher control throughput.
summary_en.experiments: Concrete model sizes, training data scale, and quantitative improvement margins are not disclosed in the abstract; extensive experiments on multiple robotic control tasks are claimed.

recommendation.zh: 机器人 VLA 方向的增量改进，互信息潜 token 设计对多模态对齐有弱参考，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: An incremental improvement in robotic VLA; the mutual-information latent token design has weak relevance to multimodal alignment, read only the method section.

paper.title: Reflective VLA: In-Context Action Consequences Make VLAs Generalize
paper.abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models are reactive: they predict the next action from the current instruction and observation, implicitly assuming that the current observation fully specifies the action-relevant state. In embodied control, however, embodiment-specific factors such as camera-to-robot geometry, robot calibration, or systematic actuation bias are often hard to identify from a single observation. As a result, reactive policies cannot reliably disambiguate these factors in general

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 模型在部署机器人上因相机几何、标定误差、执行偏差等隐变量导致的泛化失败问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLA/具身多模态策略的建模改进。它强调动作后果作为 in-context signal，比只看当前观测和指令的反应式策略更适合处理部署环境差异；但整体仍偏机器人控制应用，对 LLM 基座预训练的直接价值有限。
summary.technical_approach: Reflective VLA 在每次决策时条件化于 observation-action-consequence 三元组上下文。每个三元组记录观察、执行动作以及场景变化，用于暴露部署机器人的动作到视觉变化映射。架构上把观察模态通过 VLM 的共享注意力进行路由，使动作解释能被视觉上下文共同约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型大小、机器人平台、数据规模或定量提升。实验主张该方法能改善跨 embodiment 和部署环境泛化，但缺少可判断强度的数值细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构为 Futian Laboratory；未从给定信息确认其在 LLM/VLA 基座训练中的代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses poor deployment generalization in VLA models caused by hidden embodiment-specific factors such as camera geometry, calibration, and actuation bias.
summary_en.importance: This is a modeling improvement for embodied VLA policies. It uses action consequences as an in-context signal, which is better suited to deployment mismatch than purely reactive policies conditioned only on the current observation and instruction. Its direct value for LLM pretraining is limited because the work is mainly robotics-facing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reflective VLA conditions each decision on observation-action-consequence triplets. Each triplet stores what was observed, what action was taken, and how the scene changed, exposing the robot-specific mapping from actions to visual effects. The architecture routes observation modalities through the VLM under shared attention.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, robot platforms, data scale, or numerical gains. It claims better generalization across embodiments and deployment settings, but the strength of the evidence cannot be assessed from the provided text.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institution is Futian Laboratory. The provided information does not establish a known LLM or VLA pretraining track record.

recommendation.zh: 只看动作后果作为上下文的设定；这是具身泛化思路，不是通用多模态预训练配方。
recommendation.en: Read only the action-consequence-as-context idea; this is an embodied generalization trick, not a general multimodal pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Mix-QVLA: Task-Evidence-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: We propose Mix-QVLA, a task-evidence-aware mixed-precision PTQ framework for VLA models. Mix-QVLA anchors each quantized variant to the full-precision action-token reference decision and evaluates whether quantization preserves task-relevant evidence across key VLA functional boundaries.
