summary.core_problem: 解决 Vision-Language-Action 模型后训练量化中，传统层敏感度估计不能反映任务决策证据和执行阶段变化的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLA 推理压缩方法。它对 LLM 基座预训练不是核心，但对多模态大模型部署有一定借鉴：量化误差不只看 activation 或 weight 差异，还要看是否破坏任务相关证据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Mix-QVLA，一种 task-evidence-aware mixed-precision PTQ 框架。它把量化模型的 action-token 决策锚定到全精度参考决策，计算关键 VLA 功能边界上的归一化 gradient-weighted task-evidence maps，并用 evidence-mass 与 attribution-distribution distortion 衡量证据强度和分布是否被破坏。再通过 soft-bottleneck 目标聚合为层级敏感度，并建模不同执行阶段的层重要性变化，用于 bit allocation。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 OpenVLA-style policy 上做了广泛评测，并在模型大小和 BitOps 预算下指导混合精度分配。未提供具体模型规模、任务集、量化 bit 配置、baseline 或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses post-training quantization for Vision-Language-Action models, where standard layer sensitivity estimates may miss task-relevant evidence and phase-dependent behavior.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLA inference-compression method. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it offers a useful deployment idea for multimodal models: quantization should preserve decision evidence, not only minimize activation or weight error.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mix-QVLA is a task-evidence-aware mixed-precision PTQ framework. It anchors each quantized variant to the full-precision action-token decision, computes normalized gradient-weighted evidence maps at key VLA functional boundaries, and measures both evidence-mass and attribution-distribution distortion. A soft-bottleneck objective aggregates boundary degradation into layer sensitivity, while execution-phase modeling captures time-varying layer importance for bit allocation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports extensive evaluation on OpenVLA-style policies and mixed-precision allocation under model-size and BitOps budgets. It does not provide concrete model sizes, task suites, bit settings, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: VLA 量化的 attribution setup 可能可借到多模态 LLM；但任务很窄，读敏感度定义即可。
recommendation.en: The attribution-based sensitivity setup may transfer to multimodal LLM quantization, but the task is narrow; read only the sensitivity formulation.

paper.title: Motion-Focused Latent Action Enables Cross-Embodiment VLA Training from Human EgoVideos
paper.abstract: Training generalist Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models typically requires massive, diverse robotic datasets with high-fidelity action annotations. While egocentric human manipulation videos are abundant and capture significant environmental diversity, the absence of action labels makes them difficult to use in conventional training paradigms. To address this, we propose a latent-action-based framework designed to extract general action priors from unlabeled human videos. The architecture feature

summary.core_problem: 论文想解决 VLA 训练对机器人动作标注数据依赖过重的问题。核心难点不是简单把人类第一视角视频加入训练，而是这些视频没有动作标签，并且视觉变化里混有手部运动、相机运动、背景变化和物体状态变化。若直接用 VQ-VAE 从帧差中学习离散动作 token，codebook 容易编码无关背景动态，迁移到机器人控制时会引入噪声。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在多模态 action tokenization。论文把人类 egocentric video 看作一种可规模化的动作意图语料，用离散 latent action codebook 给 VLM 做预训练监督。这与语言模型里的 tokenizer 和预训练目标设计相近：关键不是下游控制器本身，而是如何把连续、跨 embodiment 的运动先验压缩成可预测、可迁移的离散 token。它对通用 LLM 预训练的直接影响有限，但对 VLM/VLA 统一建模、视频到动作 token 的离散化、以及无标注人类视频作为预训练数据源有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一步训练 Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE，从相邻帧中抽取跨 embodiment 的离散动作码。模型使用 frozen DINOv2 提取空间特征，再用时空 Transformer 建模帧间变化。编码器引入两组 learnable query：action query 和 background query，对应两个独立 latent 空间。随后分别经过两个 VQ bottleneck，形成 action codebook 和 background codebook。解码端用物理 mask 引导重建，使 action branch 更关注与操作相关的运动区域，background branch 吸收相机抖动、背景变化等干扰。第二步用 action code 对 VLM 做预训练，让模型从视觉观测和语言指令预测高层动作意图。第三步在目标机器人上做少量 demonstrations 适配，把 VLM 给出的意图表示与 DINOv2 感知反馈结合，再通过 flow matching action head 生成连续控制命令。论文还强调 intention-perception decoupling：高层意图来自预训练 VLM，低层执行依赖目标 embodiment 的物理反馈，避免直接把人类动作码当成机器人控制量。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 robot-to-robot 和 human-to-robot transfer。论文声称在约 50 条目标机器人轨迹下即可完成适配，并达到接近强 VLA 基线的表现。关键消融集中在 latent action 的解耦质量：若不分离 action/background，或缺少 mask-guided reconstruction，离散码会更容易编码相机运动和背景变化，迁移性能下降。实验还检查了不同 embodiment 下 learned code 的一致性，用来说明 codebook 捕获的是较抽象的 motion primitive，而不是特定机器人的关节空间动作。由于给出的正文片段未包含完整表格，具体成功率、任务数和模型规模无法可靠复述。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 分钟。重点看 Method 里的 Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE 结构图和 action/background 双 codebook 设计；其次看 downstream adaptation 中 VLM intent、DINOv2 feedback、flow matching action head 如何衔接。实验部分优先看少样本适配结果和消融表，判断性能提升到底来自人类视频预训练，还是来自更强的视觉 backbone 与控制头。若关注 LLM 预训练，可把它当作“动作 tokenizer + 无标注视频预训练目标”的案例，而不是机器人控制论文来读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the data bottleneck in VLA training. Current generalist VLA systems depend on large robot datasets with precise action annotations. Egocentric human videos are much more abundant, but they lack action labels and contain entangled visual changes: hand motion, camera motion, background variation, and object-state changes. A naive VQ-VAE over frame transitions tends to encode these nuisance factors rather than transferable manipulation intent.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is action tokenization for multimodal models. The paper treats human egocentric video as scalable pretraining data and builds a discrete latent action codebook that can supervise a VLM before robot-specific finetuning. This is close in spirit to tokenizer and objective design in language modeling: the important question is what should be discretized, what should be predicted, and which factors should be excluded from the token space. The work is less central for text LLM pretraining, but useful for VLM/VLA unified modeling and for thinking about video-to-action tokens.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three stages. First, a Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE learns discrete action codes from adjacent egocentric video frames. A frozen DINOv2 encoder extracts spatial features, and a spatiotemporal Transformer models short-term frame transitions. The encoder uses two sets of learnable queries, one for action and one for background. These are quantized by two separate VQ bottlenecks, producing an action codebook and a background codebook. A mask-guided decoder encourages the action branch to focus on physically relevant motion while pushing camera motion and background changes into the background branch. Second, the learned action codes supervise VLM pretraining: the model maps observations and language instructions to high-level action intent. Third, during robot adaptation, the pretrained intent representation is combined with DINOv2 visual feedback and a flow-matching action head to produce continuous robot controls. The intent-perception decoupling is important: the human-derived code is used as a semantic action prior, not as a direct robot command.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover both robot-to-robot and human-to-robot transfer. The paper reports that about 50 target-robot trajectories are sufficient for downstream adaptation, with performance close to strong VLA baselines. The most relevant ablations concern the latent action space. Removing the action/background disentanglement or the mask-guided reconstruction makes the codebook more sensitive to background and camera dynamics, which hurts transfer. The experiments also test cross-embodiment consistency of the learned codes, supporting the claim that the codebook captures motion primitives rather than platform-specific joint actions. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact success rates, task counts, and model sizes cannot be stated reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Focus on the Method section, especially the Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE diagram and the dual action/background codebook. Then read the adaptation pipeline to see how VLM intent, DINOv2 perception, and the flow-matching action head are connected. In the experiments, prioritize the few-shot adaptation results and the ablation table. For pretraining researchers, the useful lens is not robot control itself, but the design of an action tokenizer and a pretraining target from unlabeled human video.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法图和 VQ-VAE 细节；把人类视频离散成 action codebook 这条线，对 VLA 数据扩展比结果数字更有用。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and VQ-VAE details; the action-codebook route from human video is more useful for VLA data scaling than the reported numbers.

paper.title: Does VLA Even Know the Basics? Measuring Commonsense and World Knowledge Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Embodied Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically obtained by fine-tuning powerful pretrained VLMs on robotics data, yet it is unclear how much commonsense and factual knowledge they retain after adaptation. Failures on knowledge-sensitive tasks are ambiguous, conflating missing knowledge with poor generalization of low-level control. We introduce Act2Answer, a lightweight protocol that adapts VLM knowledge benchmarks to VLA evaluation by requiring agents to answer through action. Each

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“VLA能不能完成操作任务”，而是一个更基础也更容易被忽略的问题：把强VLM微调成VLA之后，原来在视觉常识、事实知识、语义判断上的能力还剩多少。现有VLA评测大多把失败都记成任务失败，但任务失败可能来自感知、控制、环境扰动或规划，而不一定是知识缺失。作者因此提出一个尽量剥离控制干扰的评测协议，用动作而不是文本回答，把“知识是否还能驱动正确行为”单独测出来。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在评测接口，而不是提出新的预训练方法。它把VLM→VLA适配中的知识保留问题显式化了，等于给“机器人微调是否造成灾难性遗忘”提供了一个可操作的测量工具。这个问题和持续预训练、模态迁移、post-train对表征的侵蚀都直接相关。对做统一多模态预训练的人，这篇文章的价值在于提醒：如果训练目标被动作监督强烈牵引，模型可能保留了底层表征，却失去了把知识映射成输出行为的能力；这和纯语言模型里常见的‘知道但答不出来’是同一类接口问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Act2Answer。作者把已有VLM知识基准改写成短程桌面交互episode：每道题变成一个二选一动作选择，模型通过把物体放到某个候选位置来作答，而不是生成文本。这样做有两个目的。第一，避免直接用VLA的文本头或外接解码器，因为很多VLA并不以文本作为主输出；第二，把长时程控制、复杂规划和环境随机性压到最低，让评测更接近“给定视觉场景后，模型能否把语义判断转成一个简单动作”。

数据上，作者从现有VLM benchmark中整理出 1,720 个二分类问题，覆盖 12 个类别，包括属性、状态、颜色、对称、形状、情绪、名人、生命世界、计数、时间、交通、公共信息。每个问题都被实例化为仿真环境中的单步或短步选择任务。这个设计不是追求环境复杂度，而是追求诊断性。

分析上有两个层次。第一层是模型排名：比较 7 个现代VLA 与 9 个VLM基线，观察不同知识类别上的保留程度。第二层是 layerwise intent probing：对每层表征训练线性分类器，预测该episode的正确答案，借此判断答案相关信息在网络深度中的分布，以及失败究竟是“信息没了”还是“信息在内部但没有被动作头正确读出”。这一点比单纯报成功率更有研究价值，因为它把问题从行为层拆回表征层。

从全文表述看，作者还强调了一个概念分解：embodied task success 可以粗分为 perception、knowledge、control、environment 四部分。Act2Answer 的设计就是尽量固定后三者中的控制和环境复杂度，从而更干净地测知识贡献。这种分解虽然不新，但在VLA评测里执行得比较彻底。
summary.experiments:
关键实验结论有三点。

第一，当前VLA在简单感知类类别上通常还可以，但在 richer semantic categories 上相对其源VLM出现更明显退化。也就是说，颜色、形状、基础属性这类更接近视觉判别的问题保留较多；涉及常识、世界知识、社会语义或更抽象判断的类别，掉点更明显。摘要和正文可见的定量信息主要是评测规模：7 个VLA、9 个VLM、1,720 个二分类问题、12 个知识类别。你给出的全文片段没有完整主表数字，因此不适合编造具体百分比，但论文明确声称 VLA 与 source VLM 之间在 richer semantic categories 上存在“substantially larger gaps”。

第二，带有 VQA co-training 的模型在知识敏感任务上表现更强。这个观察很重要，因为它说明动作微调并不天然保留问答式知识接口，反而需要在训练中持续维持语言/问答监督，才能减少知识到动作映射的退化。这对多任务联合预训练和mid-training recipe有直接启发。

第三，layerwise probing 显示：有些失败样例里，答案相关信息在内部表征中仍然可线性读出，但最终动作选择仍然错误。这个结果说明问题不全是灾难性遗忘，也可能是 policy head、action interface 或训练目标造成的 readout mismatch。若把它类比到LLM，这相当于中间层已有可分信息，但最终解码路径没有把它稳定释放出来。

如果精读全文，建议重点核对：不同类别中VLA与对应VLM的差距是否一致；VQA co-training 的收益是否在所有模型族都成立；probe结果是否在深层更强，还是中层已足够线性可分。这些细节决定它更像“知识丢失”还是“接口失配”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读到中度精读，重点不在方法复杂度，而在评测设计是否站得住。

建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，明确作者到底在测什么、为什么不用传统任务成功率。然后看 Methodology 里对 perception / knowledge / control / environment 的拆分，以及 Act2Answer 的任务构造细节，确认它是否真的降低了控制混杂因素。接着直接看主结果表：7 个VLA和9 个VLM在12类知识上的分布差异。最后看 layerwise intent probing 部分，这是全文最有研究味道的地方，能帮助判断失败来源。

如果时间有限，30 分钟可读完问题设定、benchmark构造和主结果；若要判断它对预训练/持续学习的启发，建议再花 20 分钟看 probing 和 VQA co-training 分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a simple but important question: after a strong VLM is adapted into a VLA policy, how much commonsense and factual knowledge is still retained and behaviorally accessible? Standard VLA evaluation collapses perception, control, planning, and environment into one task-success number, so a failure is hard to interpret. The authors aim to isolate the knowledge component by turning knowledge questions into minimal action-selection episodes.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation interface, not a new pretraining method. Still, the problem is highly relevant to foundation-model research: it operationalizes knowledge retention under modality and objective shift, which is closely related to catastrophic forgetting, continual pretraining, and pretrain-to-posttrain interface design. For multimodal foundation models, the paper makes a useful distinction between losing knowledge and losing the ability to route internal knowledge into the output action space.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is Act2Answer. Existing VLM knowledge benchmarks are converted into short tabletop episodes where the agent answers by taking a simple placement action among candidates instead of generating text. This design serves two purposes. First, many VLAs do not expose a clean text-generation interface, so text QA is not a faithful evaluation path. Second, by reducing the task to a short action episode, the benchmark minimizes confounds from long-horizon planning, motor execution, and environment complexity.

The benchmark contains 1,720 unique binary questions across 12 categories, including attribute, state, color, symmetry, shape, emotion, celebrity, living world, counting, time, traffic, and public information. The emphasis is diagnostic control rather than embodied realism.

The analysis has two layers. At the behavioral level, the paper compares 7 modern VLA systems against 9 strong VLM baselines to measure retention gaps across knowledge categories. At the representation level, it introduces layerwise intent probing: linear probes are trained on per-layer representations to predict the correct answer for each episode. This helps distinguish between two failure modes: the information is gone, or the information is still present internally but is not translated into the correct action.

A useful conceptual framing in the paper is the decomposition of embodied task success into perception, knowledge, control, and environment. Act2Answer is explicitly designed to hold control and environment complexity down so that knowledge-sensitive behavior becomes more measurable.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main empirical takeaways.

First, current VLAs tend to remain reasonably strong on simple perceptual categories, but they show noticeably larger degradation on richer semantic categories relative to their source VLMs. In other words, low-level visual distinctions such as color or shape are retained better than broader commonsense or world-knowledge judgments. From the provided full text, the reliable quantitative facts are the evaluation scale: 7 VLAs, 9 VLM baselines, 1,720 binary questions, and 12 categories. The paper explicitly claims substantially larger VLA-VLM gaps on richer semantic categories, but the exact per-category numbers are not visible in the excerpt and should not be invented.

Second, VQA co-training is associated with stronger performance on knowledge-sensitive embodied tasks. This is an important recipe-level observation: action fine-tuning alone does not guarantee preservation of the knowledge interface, while continued QA-style supervision appears to help maintain it.

Third, the layerwise probing results suggest that answer-relevant information can remain linearly decodable from internal representations even when the final action is wrong. That points to a readout or interface problem, not only catastrophic forgetting. For foundation-model researchers, this is the most interesting result in the paper because it separates representational retention from behavioral accessibility.

When reading the full experiments, the key things to verify are whether the VQA co-training effect is consistent across model families, whether the VLA-VLM gap is uniform across categories, and where in depth the probe accuracy peaks.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read as a careful evaluation paper. Start with the introduction and the main figure to understand what is being measured and why standard task success is insufficient. Then read the benchmark construction and the perception/knowledge/control/environment decomposition in the methodology. After that, go directly to the main comparison tables between the 7 VLAs and 9 VLMs across the 12 categories. Finish with the layerwise intent probing section, which contains the most informative analysis.

If time is limited, 30 minutes is enough for the setup, benchmark design, and headline results. Add another 20 minutes for the probing section if you care about forgetting versus readout mismatch.

recommendation.zh: 把“微调后知识遗忘”与“控制执行失败”解耦得较干净，做视觉-动作统一建模的应读 §3 和探针结果。
recommendation.en: Cleanly disentangles post-fine-tuning knowledge forgetting from control failure; read §3 and the probing results if you work on vision–action co-training.

paper.title: MuseVLA: An Adaptive Multimodal Sensing Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
paper.abstract: Humans naturally leverage diverse sensing modalities to interact with the physical world, while most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotics rely solely on RGB observations. This limits their ability to perceive physical properties that are difficult or impossible to infer from RGB cameras, such as temperature, sound, or radar response. summary.core_problem: 现有机器人Vision-Language-Action (VLA) 模型仅依赖RGB视觉，无法感知温度、声音、雷达等物理属性。
summary.importance: 首次将传感器作为可调用工具集成到VLA模型中，在多模态机器人感知层面有一定方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: MuseVLA首先生成传感器token和目标描述来选择感知模态（类似工具调用），然后将传感器测量值转换为统一的'传感器图像'中间表示，实现异质传感器数据与VLA骨干网络的解耦融合。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体实验参数和量化结果。
summary.authors_note: Xingyuming Liu等，含Jiaolong Yang、Baining Guo（微软亚洲研究院资深研究者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Current robotic Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely solely on RGB vision, unable to perceive physical properties like temperature, sound, or radar signals.
summary_en.importance: First integration of sensors as callable tools in a VLA model, with some methodological novelty in multimodal robotic perception.
summary_en.technical_approach: MuseVLA first generates a sensor token and target description to select a sensing modality (analogous to tool calling), then converts the sensor measurement into a unified 'sensor image' intermediate representation for decoupled fusion with the VLA backbone.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental parameters and quantitative results not provided in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Xingyuming Liu et al., including Jiaolong Yang and Baining Guo (senior researchers at Microsoft Research Asia).

recommendation.zh: 将传感器视为可调用工具的思想对多模态LLM的工具扩展有微弱启发，但核心是机器人应用，可略读摘要了解思路。
recommendation.en: The sensor-as-callable-tool idea provides minor inspiration for multimodal LLM tool extension, but the core is robotics application — skim the abstract only.

paper.title: PearlVLA: Progressive Embodied Action-Plan Refinement in Latent Space
paper.abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models face a trade-off between efficient action generation and explicit deliberation. Directly decoding actions from vision-language backbone representations enables low-latency control, whereas explicit reasoning through textual chains, pixel-level subgoals, or action search can improve planning but incurs substantial latency and computational cost. We propose PearlVLA, a VLA framework that moves deliberation into the latent space of a vision-language model

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型存在低延迟直接解码与显式推理规划的性能trade-off，显式推理方法延迟高、计算开销大。
summary.importance: 方法创新类贡献，提出将规划过程迁移到VLM latent空间的范式，兼顾具身操控的推理能力与低延迟要求。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PearlVLA框架，拆分VLM元查询为固定视觉grounding分支与迭代latent规划分支，通过轻量冻结latent世界模型输出无动作的未来观测latent引导规划，用RefineNet逐步将粗语义草稿细化为细粒度动作计划。
summary.experiments: 在具身操控基准上测试，对比直接解码与显式推理基线，在相近延迟下提升规划成功率，延迟显著低于文本链/像素子目标等显式推理方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models face a tradeoff between low-latency direct decoding and explicit reasoning planning, with explicit reasoning methods incurring high latency and computational cost.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation contribution; proposes a paradigm that shifts planning to the VLM latent space to balance reasoning capability and low latency for embodied manipulation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PearlVLA framework: splits VLM meta-queries into a fixed visual grounding branch and iterative latent planning branch, uses a lightweight frozen latent world model to output action-free future observation latents for planning guidance, and applies RefineNet to progressively refine coarse semantic drafts into fine-grained action plans.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on embodied manipulation benchmarks; compared to direct decoding and explicit reasoning baselines, it improves planning success rate under similar latency, with significantly lower latency than explicit reasoning methods like text chains or pixel-level subgoals.

recommendation.zh: 具身VLA领域的架构增量改进，与纯文本LLM预训练关联弱，仅做多模态预训练的研究员可略读摘要。
recommendation.en: Incremental architecture improvement for embodied VLA, weak relevance to text-only LLM pretraining; multimodal pretrain researchers can skim the abstract only.

paper.title: X-Tokenizer: A Multimodal Action Tokenizer for Vision-Language-Action Pretraining
paper.abstract: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models must bridge pretrained vision-language reasoning and precise continuous robot control. Existing action tokenizers discretize actions primarily for reconstruction, producing codes that preserve motion geometry but provide only weak semantic supervision to the backbone. We therefore formulate action tokenization not as mere compression, but as semantic interface learning between multimodal reasoning and executable control. To this end, we introduce X-Toke

summary.core_problem: 为 Vision-Language-Action 预训练设计一种动作 tokenizer，使连续机器人控制既能被离散建模，又能向 VLA backbone 提供语义监督。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是跨模态 tokenization 和统一预训练接口设计。它把动作离散化从“重建压缩”改成“语义接口学习”，对把机器人动作、视觉和语言放进同一个 LM/VLM 训练空间有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 X-Tokenizer，一个轻量 encoder-Semantic Residual Quantization-decoder 架构。SRQ 对残差向量量化做非对称设计：第一层用 Masked Action Modeling 训练，形成表示粗粒度运动意图的离散动作语言；更深层保留重建导向的 residual code，用于保存精细控制细节。整体目标是在多种机械臂 embodiment 间共享动作接口。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供完整实验细节、模型规模、机器人数据规模、baseline 或数值提升。可确认的实验目标是评估该 tokenizer 在多样机械臂动作上的共享表达、语义对齐和重建控制能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper designs an action tokenizer for Vision-Language-Action pretraining, aiming to bridge pretrained multimodal reasoning and continuous robot control.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a tokenization interface for unified multimodal-action pretraining. The key shift is treating action discretization as semantic interface learning rather than pure reconstruction.
summary_en.technical_approach: X-Tokenizer uses a lightweight encoder-Semantic Residual Quantization-decoder design. SRQ makes residual quantization asymmetric: the first level is trained with Masked Action Modeling to capture coarse motion intent as a discrete action language, while deeper levels remain reconstruction-oriented residual codes for fine-grained control.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include model size, dataset scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears to target shared action representation, semantic alignment, and reconstruction quality across robotic-arm embodiments.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 SRQ 设计；它把动作 token 的第一层变成语义码，而不是只追求重建误差。
recommendation.en: Skim the SRQ design; the useful idea is making the first action-code level semantic rather than purely reconstructive.

paper.title: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA: From Vision-Language-Action Models to a Real-World Robot Learning Stack
paper.abstract: In this report, we present Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA, abbreviated as HyVLA-0.5, an end-to-end system that spans the full robot learning stack: data collection, model design, continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, RL post-training, and real-world deployment. Each component serves a distinct role in this stack.

summary.core_problem: 把 VLA 模型从单个策略网络扩展成可在真实机器人上部署的完整学习栈，覆盖数据、模型、继续预训练、SFT、RL 后训练和部署。
summary.importance: 贡献是系统技术报告，而不是单点算法。对预训练研究员的价值在于观察 embodied VLA 如何组织 continue pretraining、监督微调和 RL post-training 的接口。
summary.technical_approach: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA 描述端到端 robot learning stack。摘要明确包括数据采集、模型设计、continued pre-training、supervised fine-tuning、RL post-training 和真实世界部署；各组件在栈中承担不同角色。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要未披露模型参数量、数据规模、机器人任务集、baseline 或量化结果。只能确认其定位为真实机器人系统报告，强调从训练到部署的全链路而非单一 benchmark。

summary_en.core_problem: The report aims to turn VLA models into a deployable real-world robot learning stack spanning data, model design, continued pretraining, SFT, RL post-training, and deployment.
summary_en.importance: This is a system report rather than a single algorithmic contribution. For pretraining researchers, the relevant part is how an embodied VLA stack connects continued pretraining, supervised tuning, and RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hy-Embodied-0.5-VLA is presented as an end-to-end robot learning stack. The abstract lists data collection, model design, continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, RL post-training, and real-world deployment as coordinated components.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify model size, data scale, robot task suite, baselines, or quantitative gains. It frames the work as a full-stack real-world deployment report.

recommendation.zh: 若做 embodied pretrain，可扫训练栈接口；摘要看不出新的建模范式，别按基础模型技术报告读。
recommendation.en: Skim the training-stack interfaces if you work on embodied pretraining; the abstract does not indicate a new modeling paradigm.

paper.title: Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning: Self-Aware Policy Execution for VLA Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are powerful action generators for robot manipulation, but they are typically executed with fixed inference and replanning schedules. This rigidity ignores the uneven difficulty of robot control: contact-rich or uncertain states may need more computation and fresher feedback, while easier states can often be handled with fewer inference steps and longer open-loop execution. We propose Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning (EQRL), a framework that makes each V

summary.core_problem: VLA 机器人策略通常用固定推理频率、固定去噪步数和固定动作块长度执行，无法按状态难度分配计算量。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向具身策略执行的自适应 test-time compute 框架。它不改底层 VLA 模型，而是在执行层决定何时多算、何时少算，对预训练研究的价值主要在于多模态策略的动态计算分配思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning。轻量 latent-schedule adaptor 联合选择 latent input、denoising budget 和 action chunk length；用 critic ensemble 对 joint latent-schedule action 建模，并用 critic 分歧估计状态难度；难状态分配更多计算和更短开环执行，简单状态减少查询频率。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体机器人任务数量、底层 VLA 参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或提升幅度。可确认的是方法定位为不微调底层 VLA，只训练执行调度模块，并面向 contact-rich 或不确定状态的机器人 manipulation。

summary_en.core_problem: VLA policies are usually executed with fixed inference and replanning schedules, which wastes compute on easy states and under-computes hard contact-rich states.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an adaptive execution-time compute allocation framework for embodied VLA policies. Its relevance to pretraining research is indirect: it gives a concrete example of difficulty-aware compute scheduling for multimodal action models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning. A lightweight latent-schedule adaptor jointly selects latent input, denoising budget, and action chunk length. A critic ensemble over the joint latent-schedule action estimates state difficulty via disagreement, and a residual component allows task-driven corrections.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, dataset scale, exact baselines, or quantitative gains. It states that the underlying VLA model is not fine-tuned and the learned scheduling module targets robot manipulation with variable chunk execution.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLA 执行层的动态算力分配案例看即可；预训练侧别过度解读，只扫 adaptor 和 critic disagreement 设计。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an execution-time compute allocation case for VLA policies; skim the adaptor and critic-disagreement design, not the robotics claims.

paper.title: $μ$VLA: On Recurrent Memory for Partially Observable Manipulation in VLA Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions from the current observation, an assumption that fails under partial observability, where decisions depend on information no longer visible. Existing memory-augmented VLAs simultaneously introduce recurrence, retrieval, compression modules, auxiliary objectives, hierarchical memory, or task-specific architectural changes, so the contribution of recurrence itself remains entangled with surrounding machinery. We present a control

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLA 模型在部分可观测操控任务中，是否仅靠简单 recurrent memory 就能弥补当前观测不足。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是受控消融和多模态行动模型的记忆机制分析。它对 LLM 基座预训练不是直接贡献，但对长时序、多步交互、memory token 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在强预训练 VLA backbone 上加入少量可学习 memory tokens，这些 tokens 跨时间步传递，并通过 self-attention 更新。训练采用 truncated backpropagation through time，不加 retrieval、压缩模块、辅助目标或任务特化结构，以隔离 recurrence 本身的作用。模型族基于 OpenVLA-OFT，变量包括 memory width m、TBPTT length K 和 memory update rule。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验围绕 OpenVLA-OFT 变体展开，并系统改变 memory 宽度、TBPTT 长度和更新规则。具体任务集、模型参数量、baseline 数值和提升幅度在给定摘要中未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a simple recurrent memory mechanism is sufficient to improve VLA models under partial observability.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a controlled ablation of memory in vision-language-action models. It is not a direct LLM pretraining result, but it is relevant to long-horizon interaction and memory-token design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors add a small set of learnable memory tokens to a strong pretrained VLA backbone. These tokens are carried across timesteps and updated through self-attention, trained end-to-end with truncated backpropagation through time. The design deliberately avoids retrieval, compression modules, auxiliary losses, hierarchy, or task-specific architectural changes. The μVLA family is instantiated from OpenVLA-OFT with variations in memory width, TBPTT length, and update rule.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that experiments use OpenVLA-OFT variants and vary memory width, TBPTT length, and memory update rules. Specific task suites, model sizes, baselines, and numerical gains are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为 memory-token clean ablation 看摘要和实验表即可；机器人 setup 太窄，不足以直接外推到通用 LLM。
recommendation.en: Use it as a clean memory-token ablation; read the abstract and tables, but the robotics setup is too narrow to directly transfer to general LLMs.

paper.title: When Does Language Matter? Multilingual Instructions Reveal Step-wise Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet their robustness to linguistic variation remains poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic multilingual evaluation of VLA models by translating the LIBERO benchmark into ten languages, revealing severe performance degradation under non-English instructions, with success rates dropping by 30-50%. Through fine-grained analysis of task executions, we find that l

summary.core_problem: 系统分析视觉-语言-动作模型在多语言指令下何时失效，并定位语言敏感性是否集中在任务执行的特定步骤。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测与诊断：把 LIBERO 扩展到十种语言，并提出 step-wise 语言敏感性分析。对多模态统一预训练和 instruction robustness 有间接启发，但不是基座训练论文。
summary.technical_approach: 将 LIBERO benchmark 翻译为十种语言，做细粒度步骤级执行分析，发现语言影响在不同步骤上高度不均匀；据此提出一种 inference-time step-wise intervention，根据步骤的语言敏感性对表示进行对齐。
summary.experiments: 在 VLA 模型上，多语言指令会导致 30%-50% 的成功率下降。所提步骤级干预能显著缓解非英语指令下的性能退化。摘要未给出具体模型名称和提升绝对值，但诊断信号比较清楚。
summary.authors_note: 哈尔滨工业大学团队，工作更偏 VLA 评测与鲁棒性分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper systematically studies when vision-language-action models fail under multilingual instructions, and whether language sensitivity concentrates on specific execution steps.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is evaluation and diagnosis: LIBERO is translated into ten languages, and step-wise language sensitivity is analyzed. It has indirect value for multimodal pretraining and instruction robustness, but it is not a foundation-training paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a multilingual version of the LIBERO benchmark, perform fine-grained step-level execution analysis, and show that language effects are highly non-uniform across steps. Based on this, they propose an inference-time step-wise intervention that aligns representations according to step language sensitivity.
summary_en.experiments: On VLA models, non-English instructions reduce success rates by 30% to 50%. The proposed step-wise intervention substantially recovers performance under multilingual variation. The abstract does not list exact model names or absolute gains, but the diagnostic signal is clear.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Harbin Institute of Technology and is primarily about VLA evaluation and robustness analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“语言影响集中在少数关键步骤”这个诊断值得记住；做多模态统一训练时，可把它当 error attribution 的线索。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the finding that language sensitivity concentrates in a few critical steps is worth keeping in mind for multimodal error attribution.

paper.title: DAM-VLA: Decoupled Asynchronous Multimodal Vision Language Action model
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models inherit a shared synchronous clock from vision-language pretraining, processing every input at one rate. This is misaligned with physical interaction, where a high-frequency modality changes at hundreds of hertz, vision evolves more slowly, and language stays constant across an episode. A synchronous VLA oversamples slow modalities, undersamples fast ones, and caps action generation at the lowest effective frequency. We hypothesize that decoupling temporal pro

summary.core_problem: 现有VLA模型继承VL预训练的同步时钟假设，无法适配物理交互中不同模态更新速率差异，导致高频模态欠采样、性能受限
summary.importance: 提出解耦异步时序的多模态VLA架构，在不改动预训练主干的前提下支持异频模态接入
summary.technical_approach: 为每个模态维护独立的隐状态缓冲区，按各自传感器频率刷新，动作头持续读取缓冲区输出；新增高频模态通过门控交叉注意力接入，全程冻结预训练主干
summary.experiments: 在7个真实世界接触丰富的机器人操作任务上，平均成功率较同步VLA基线提升1倍以上

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLA models inherit the synchronous clock assumption from vision-language pretraining, which mismatches the varying update rates of different modalities in physical interaction, leading to undersampling of high-frequency modalities and limited performance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a decoupled asynchronous multimodal VLA architecture that supports integration of modalities with different sampling rates without modifying the pretrained backbone.
summary_en.technical_approach: Maintains per-modality latent buffers refreshed at native sensor rates, continuously read by the action head; new high-frequency modalities are integrated via gated cross-attention while keeping the pretrained backbone fully frozen.
summary_en.experiments: Across 7 real-world contact-rich robot manipulation tasks, average success rate is more than double that of synchronous VLA baselines.

recommendation.zh: 异步多模态解耦思路有一定参考性，但设计针对机器人场景，无通用多模态预训练实验，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: The asynchronous multimodal decoupling idea is a useful reference, but the design is robotics-specific with no general multimodal pretraining experiments; read the abstract only.

paper.title: YUBI: Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation at Scale
paper.abstract: We introduce Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface (YUBI), a finger-aligned gripper designed to enable intuitive, ergonomic, and scalable data collection for bimanual dexterous manipulation. While handheld data collection systems such as Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enable affordable data collection, their bulky pistol-grip designs can pose ergonomic and usability challenges for fine-grained, dexterous manipulation tasks. To address this, YUBI presents a distinct design principle: yie

summary.core_problem: 为双手灵巧操作构建更自然、可规模化的人类示教采集接口，并收集大规模机器人操作轨迹数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机器人/VLA 数据采集系统和数据资产。8,434 小时、120 万 episodes、119 个任务的规模对 embodied foundation model 有参考意义，但它主要解决机器人示教硬件和轨迹采集问题，不是 LLM 基座预训练核心问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 YUBI，一种手指对齐、yielding、finger-driven 的双指夹爪接口，将人手指运动直接映射到夹爪开合；系统结合 VR 6DoF tracking，采集高保真轨迹，并与 UMI 风格的数据采集流程对比。
summary.experiments: 构建了 8,434 小时、1.20M episodes、119 个任务的数据集。摘要称 YUBI 在复杂双手任务、多样性、灵巧性和操作性方面优于 UMI gripper，但未提供具体成功率、模型规模或训练效果数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a more natural and scalable human demonstration interface for bimanual dexterous manipulation, together with a large robot trajectory dataset.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a robot/VLA data collection system and dataset. The reported scale, 8,434 hours, 1.20M episodes, and 119 tasks, is relevant to embodied foundation-model data, but the core problem is robotics demonstration hardware rather than LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: YUBI is a finger-aligned, yielding, finger-driven bidigital gripper interface that maps human finger motion directly to gripper jaw motion. The system integrates VR-based 6DoF tracking to collect high-fidelity trajectories and compares against UMI-style handheld collection.
summary_en.experiments: The paper curates a dataset with 8,434 hours, 1.20M episodes, and 119 tasks. The abstract reports advantages over UMI grippers in complex bimanual tasks, dexterity, versatility, and usability, but does not provide exact success rates or model-training numbers.

recommendation.zh: 机器人数据规模值得记一笔，但主要是采集硬件论文；对文本/多模态预训练只提供数据工程侧弱信号。
recommendation.en: The data scale is worth noting, but this is mostly a collection-hardware paper; for text or multimodal pretraining it is only a weak data-engineering signal.

paper.title: TBD-VLA: Temporal Block Diffusion Vision Language Action Model
paper.abstract: Discrete Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically formulate action generation as next-token prediction over discretized action spaces, conditioning each token autoregressively on prior context. While effective, this paradigm incurs high inference latency and largely ignores the temporal structure inherent in action trajectories. Recent efforts introduce parallel decoding to improve efficiency, enabling faster inference, but lack explicit mechanisms for modeling token dependencies. We introd

summary.core_problem: 现有离散视觉语言动作（VLA）模型要么采用自回归生成动作导致推理延迟高，要么用并行解码但缺乏token依赖建模，忽略动作轨迹的固有时间结构。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出了时间分块离散扩散与跨块自回归结合的混合生成范式，平衡了动作生成的推理速度与时间连贯性。
summary.technical_approach: 将动作序列划分为时间块，块内执行掩码离散扩散实现并行解码，块间维持自回归建模时序依赖，统一了两种生成机制的优势。
summary.experiments: 未明确给出模型参数量与具体基线数值，仅说明设计在时间连贯性和推理速度上均有提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing discrete Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models either use autoregressive action generation with high inference latency, or parallel decoding without explicit token dependency modeling, ignoring the inherent temporal structure of action trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a hybrid generation paradigm combining temporal block-wise discrete diffusion and cross-block autoregression, balancing inference speed and temporal coherence of action generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Partition action sequences into temporal blocks, perform masked discrete diffusion within each block for parallel decoding, and maintain autoregressive modeling across blocks to capture temporal dependencies, unifying the advantages of both generation mechanisms.
summary_en.experiments: No explicit model parameter count or specific baseline metrics are provided; the design is stated to achieve improvements in both temporal coherence and inference speed.

recommendation.zh: 块级扩散与跨块自回归的混合生成设计可参考，仅需看方法部分的分块机制即可。
recommendation.en: The hybrid block-wise diffusion and cross-block autoregression design is worth referencing; only review the block partitioning mechanism in the method section.

paper.title: Scaling by Diversified Experience for Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models face significant challenges in real-world deployment due to the entanglement of high-level reasoning with low-level control, and the instability of policy optimization. In this paper, we introduce SyVLA, a robust VLA model trained with diversified experiences. We propose an Intention Decoupling algorithm to isolate control-relevant features from reasoning contexts and a similar-sample guided RL pipeline to stabilize policy updates and mitigate distribution shift. Ex

summary.core_problem: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在真实部署中存在高层推理与底层控制特征纠缠、策略优化不稳定的问题
summary.importance: 提出VLA训练的解耦与RL稳定方法，属于多模态机器人agent领域的增量方法创新，提升了真实机器人任务的成功率与泛化性
summary.technical_approach: 提出SyVLA框架，包含意图解耦算法分离控制相关特征与推理上下文，以及相似样本引导的RL管线，缓解分布偏移并稳定策略更新
summary.experiments: 在真实机器人任务与多模态基准上测试，相比现有方法任务成功率更高，分布外泛化性更强，同时保留核心视觉语言能力
summary.authors_note: 上海交通大学卢策吾团队，卢策吾为计算机视觉与机器人领域知名学者

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models suffer from entanglement of high-level reasoning and low-level control, as well as unstable policy optimization during real-world deployment
summary_en.importance: Proposes decoupling and RL stabilization methods for VLA training, an incremental methodological innovation in multimodal robotics agent domain, improving task success rate and generalization of real robots
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SyVLA framework, including an Intention Decoupling algorithm to separate control-relevant features from reasoning contexts, and a similar-sample guided RL pipeline to mitigate distribution shift and stabilize policy updates
summary_en.experiments: Tested on real-world robotic tasks and multimodal benchmarks, achieves higher task success rate and stronger out-of-distribution generalization than existing methods, while preserving core vision-language capabilities
summary_en.authors_note: Cewu Lu's group at Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Cewu Lu is a well-known scholar in computer vision and robotics

recommendation.zh: 推理与控制特征解耦的思路对多模态预训练对齐有微弱参考，仅作领域动态了解即可
recommendation.en: The decoupling idea of reasoning and control features has marginal reference for multimodal pretraining alignment; only for domain trend awareness.

paper.title: RhinoVLA Technical Report
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation, but real-time deployment on edge hardware remains challenging. In this work, we identify VLM visual and context tokens as a major source of deployment latency: for GEMM-dominated projection operators, computation grows linearly with the number of input tokens when model dimensions are fixed. Motivated by this observation, we propose RhinoVLA, a deployment-oriented VLA model co-designed with the Huixi R1 edg

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 模型在边缘硬件实时部署时，视觉与上下文 token 数过多导致投影算子和整体推理延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 这是部署导向的 VLA 技术报告，价值主要在多模态 token 效率与软硬件协同设计。对做统一多模态预训练的人有一些启发，但离 LLM 基座预训练主线仍有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RhinoVLA：基于 token-efficient 的 Qwen3-VL 骨干和连续动作专家，减少 VLM 侧 token 与计算负担；同时设计统一机器人接口，把 View Registry、72 维物理状态-动作槽位和 robot-instance LoRA 结合起来，以支持异构机器人在共享策略下对齐观测与动作空间；部署上与 Huixi R1 边缘 SoC 协同优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调部署延迟来自输入 token 数线性增长，并声称在跨机器人学习和边缘部署上有效，但未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、主要 baseline 和具体性能/时延数字。更像系统技术报告而非可复用的预训练 recipe。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Huixi Intelligence，属于机器人/VLA 工程团队；从题目和摘要看，重点是 edge deployment 与 VLA 软硬件协同，而不是通用多模态基座训练。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the real-time deployment bottleneck of VLA models on edge hardware, where too many visual and context tokens drive up projection cost and end-to-end latency.
summary_en.importance: This is a deployment-oriented VLA technical report. Its main value lies in multimodal token efficiency and hardware-software co-design. It offers some signal for unified multimodal pretraining, but it is still off the main path of LLM foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: RhinoVLA uses a token-efficient Qwen3-VL backbone plus a continuous action expert to reduce VLM-side token and compute load. It also introduces a unified robot interface combining a View Registry, a 72D physical state-action slot space, and robot-instance LoRA to align heterogeneous robot observations and action schemas under a shared policy, co-designed with the Huixi R1 edge SoC.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract argues that latency scales linearly with input token count for GEMM-dominated projection operators and claims gains in cross-robot learning and edge deployment, but does not report model size, training scale, baselines, or concrete quality/latency numbers. It reads more like a systems technical report than a reusable pretraining recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Huixi Intelligence, apparently a robotics/VLA engineering team. From the title and abstract, the emphasis is edge deployment and VLA hardware-software co-design rather than general multimodal foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 native multimodal，可只看它对 token 数与延迟线性关系的拆解；其余多是机器人接口工程，别误当成预训练论文。
recommendation.en: If you work on native multimodal models, only the token-count vs latency breakdown is worth skimming; the rest is mostly robotics interface engineering.

paper.title: AURA: Action-Gated Memory for Robot Policies at Constant VRAM
paper.abstract: The KV-cache is the right memory for datacenters but the wrong memory for robots. Datacenter inference batches many short requests and resets them, amortizing an attention cache across a crowd. Embodied agents instead run one long, non-resetting episode on bandwidth-limited edge hardware, where high-bandwidth memory and flash are scarce, flash has finite write endurance, and memory writes rather than compute can become the binding constraint.   AURA-Mem (Action-Utility Recurrent Adaptive Memory)

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个很具体、也很现实的问题：把 Transformer 式 KV-cache 直接搬到长时运行的机器人策略里，内存占用和写带宽都会随时间线性增长，最后瓶颈不在算力，而在显存和写入。数据中心里的短请求可以 reset，cache 成本能被摊薄；机器人却是在一个几乎不重置的连续 episode 中运行，控制步数越长，历史越长，cache 越大。作者要解决的核心问题，是如何在固定显存下，为 embodied policy 提供一个常数大小、低写频率、又足够保留决策相关历史信息的记忆机制，并且这个记忆不是为重建过去服务，而是直接为“下一步动作是否正确”服务。
summary.importance: 它对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不高，因为主要场景是机器人 policy memory，而不是语言模型预训练。但从架构和推理状态设计角度，它有两个可借鉴点。第一，作者把“记忆该不该写入”变成一个受动作效用约束的学习问题，而不是默认每步都更新状态。这对长上下文推理、流式多模态模型、以及持续交互式 agent 的状态压缩有启发。第二，文章明确把 memory write bandwidth 当成一等公民来优化，而不是只看 FLOPs 或参数量。这种视角对边缘部署、长时对话、以及未来统一 agent memory 设计是有价值的。若从预训练研究角度看，它更像一篇 architecture/inference-state 论文，而不是 pretrain 论文。
summary.technical_approach: AURA-Mem 的设计可以概括为“冻结大 backbone + 常数状态记忆 + 动作驱动写门控”。具体有四个关键部件。第一，外层包一个 constant-size recurrent memory，替代随时间增长的 KV-cache。无论 episode 多长，显存中的状态大小不变。第二，引入 learned action-utility write gate。门控的触发信号不是语言建模里常见的 perplexity、也不是 recency eviction，而是当前观测是否会改变下一步动作。如果当前信息对动作决策没有增量价值，就不写。第三，训练目标不是重建观测或预测 token，而是 action-information bottleneck。作者直接用动作 chunk loss 反传到 gate 决策，让模型学会保留“对动作有用的信息”，而不是“对还原历史有用的信息”。第四，训练时显式控制写率。文中用目标写率 rho 和惩罚系数 gamma，在训练阶段把模型放到不同的 accuracy/write-bandwidth tradeoff 点上。除此之外，作者还尝试把 approximate information state 的理论框架落地，实测 epsilon、delta 这两个量，给出一个 action-sufficiency certificate。虽然带上 Lipschitz 常数后的 value-loss bound 在当前规模下仍然偏松，几乎不够用，但至少把“压缩状态是否足够支持决策”从口头叙事推进到了可测量对象。与 SSM 类方法相比，它不是每步必写；与 KV-cache 压缩/淘汰方法相比，它不是在增长 cache 上做近似，而是从一开始就坚持 O(1) state；与 Tensor Cache 这类 fast-weight 结构相比，差别在于写入触发依据、训练目标、写率控制和理论测量四点同时不同。
summary.experiments: 实验主结论不是精度超过所有基线，而是在相近任务成功率下，把写入次数显著降下来。作者反复强调 primary result 是 write-bandwidth frontier。文中给出的核心数字是：在 memory-dependent synthetic benchmarks 上，AURA-Mem 相比 write-everything 的 dense baseline，达到 4.98–9.19 倍更少的 memory writes，同时与最佳 O(1) baseline（fixed_size_state）保持 accuracy parity，配对 bootstrap 置信区间包含 0，样本数 N=64。理论测量部分，作者报告 shipped checkpoint 上 epsilon_mean=0.0021，epsilon_q95=0.0076；但由于 L_V 相关项过大，完整 bound 仍然是 vacuous，所以真正有信息量的是测得的 epsilon，而不是最终 value bound。实验设置还比较了几类相关路线：一类是每步都写的 bounded-state/SSM 风格基线，一类是 KV-cache compression/eviction 方法，另一类是结构上更接近的 Tensor Cache。文章的论证方式比较克制：它不声称在任务成功率上全面领先，而是证明在常数显存前提下，AURA-Mem 能把“写多少次”这个硬件敏感指标压下去，而且这个压缩不是靠简单少写导致性能崩掉。若你关心的是长时 agent 或边缘设备上的持续推理，这个结果是有意义的；若关心纯 LLM 预训练收益，则需要自己做迁移判断。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction 前半段，作者对 KV-cache 在 datacenter 与 robot 两种运行条件下的差异讲得很清楚，问题设定值得看。然后直接看方法部分里关于 write gate、action-IB objective、以及 write-rate control 的定义，弄清楚 gate 的监督信号到底来自哪里，和普通 recurrent update 有什么不同。接着看与 AIS bound 相关的章节，重点不是公式推导本身，而是作者如何把 epsilon、delta 变成可测量量，以及为什么最终 bound 仍然偏松。实验部分优先看 write-bandwidth frontier 图、与 fixed_size_state/Tensor Cache 的对比、以及不同 rho 下的 tradeoff 曲线。预计 25–35 分钟可以完成有效泛读。如果你做的是 LLM 长上下文或 streaming memory，可以重点思考“是否可以把 token-level state update 也改成 utility-gated write”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete systems-and-architecture problem: a Transformer-style KV cache is a poor memory abstraction for robots that run in one long, effectively non-resetting episode. In that regime, memory usage and write bandwidth grow linearly with time, and the bottleneck eventually becomes VRAM and memory traffic rather than compute. Datacenter inference can amortize cache costs across many short requests; embodied control cannot. The core question is therefore how to build a constant-size memory for a long-horizon policy that writes infrequently, preserves action-relevant history, and is optimized for decision quality rather than for reconstructing the past.
summary_en.importance: This is not directly a pretraining paper, and its relevance to LLM foundation-model research is indirect. Still, it offers two useful ideas. First, it treats memory writing as a learned utility decision instead of a default per-step update. That is relevant to long-context inference, streaming multimodal models, and interactive agents where state growth becomes the real deployment bottleneck. Second, it elevates memory-write bandwidth to a first-class optimization target, rather than focusing only on FLOPs or parameter count. That perspective is useful for edge deployment and for any future work on persistent agent memory. From an LLM-research viewpoint, this fits better under architecture or inference-state design than under pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: AURA-Mem can be summarized as a frozen backbone plus a constant-size recurrent memory plus an action-driven write gate. There are four main ingredients. First, the model wraps a fixed-size memory around a frozen vision-language-action backbone, replacing the linearly growing KV cache with an O(1) state. Second, it introduces a learned action-utility write gate. The trigger is not perplexity, recency, or generic reconstruction error; it is whether the current observation would change the next action. If the new input is not useful for action selection, the memory does not write. Third, the training objective is an action-information bottleneck rather than observation reconstruction. The action-chunk loss is backpropagated through the gate decision so that the memory learns to retain what matters for acting well, not what best preserves token-level fidelity. Fourth, the method includes explicit write-rate control during training via a target write rate rho and a penalty weight gamma, allowing the model to move along an accuracy-versus-write-bandwidth frontier. The paper also instantiates the approximate information state framework empirically by measuring epsilon and delta for the learned memory and reporting an action-sufficiency certificate. The full value-loss bound remains loose because the Lipschitz-related term is too large at current scale, but the attempt is still notable: it turns 'is this compressed state sufficient for control?' into something measurable. Relative to SSM-style recurrent models, AURA-Mem does not write every step. Relative to KV-cache compression methods, it does not approximate a growing cache; it commits to constant memory from the start. Relative to Tensor Cache, it differs simultaneously in write trigger, training objective, write-rate conditioning, and the measured action-sufficiency analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical claim is not superior task accuracy, but a better write-bandwidth frontier at matched performance. On memory-dependent synthetic benchmarks, AURA-Mem achieves 4.98x to 9.19x fewer memory writes than a write-everything dense baseline while maintaining statistical parity with the best O(1) baseline, fixed_size_state; the paired bootstrap confidence interval includes zero at N=64. The paper is careful about this framing: the result is reduced writes without collapsing task success, not universal accuracy dominance. On the theory-measurement side, the shipped checkpoint reports epsilon_mean = 0.0021 and epsilon_q95 = 0.0076. However, once the L_V term is included, the full bound is still vacuous, so the practically informative quantity is the measured epsilon rather than the final value-loss certificate. The experiments compare against several families: bounded-state models that write every step, KV-cache compression or eviction methods, and the structurally related Tensor Cache. If your interest is persistent inference on edge hardware or long-horizon agents, the results are meaningful. If your interest is pure LLM pretraining, the transfer path is less direct and needs interpretation.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the first half of the introduction. The contrast between datacenter KV-cache economics and robot-memory economics is clearly stated and worth understanding. Then jump to the method sections defining the write gate, the action-IB objective, and the write-rate control; the key question is what supervises the gate and how that differs from a standard recurrent update. After that, read the AIS-related section, not mainly for the derivation, but for how epsilon and delta are operationalized and why the final bound remains loose. In the experiments, prioritize the write-bandwidth frontier plots, the comparisons with fixed_size_state and Tensor Cache, and the tradeoff curves across different rho settings. A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes. If you work on long-context LLMs or streaming memory, the most transferable idea is utility-gated state writing.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim 门控训练目标；“按 action utility 写记忆”比又一个压缩 KV 更像可迁移的长程记忆假设。
recommendation.en: Skim the gating objective; writing memory by action utility is a more transferable long-horizon hypothesis than another KV-compression trick.

paper.title: VLA-Pro: Cross-Task Procedural Memory Transfer for Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action~(VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet they still struggle to generalize to unseen tasks that necessitate transferring relevant experience across objects, scenes, and action patterns. This paper proposes VLA-Pro, a plug-and-play framework designed to enhance cross-task generalization by storing task-relevant procedural memories at training time and transferring these memories during inference. Specifically, VLA-Pro stores tas

summary.core_problem: 提升 Vision-Language-Action 模型在未见机器人任务上的跨任务泛化，尤其是需要迁移对象、场景和动作模式经验的任务。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLA 推理时记忆迁移机制：把任务 LoRA 适配器当作程序性记忆检索和融合。对通用多模态预训练不是直接贡献，但与参数化记忆、adapter 路由和模块组合有关。
summary.technical_approach: VLA-Pro 在训练阶段为不同任务保存 task-specific LoRA adapters，作为参数化 procedural memories；推理时根据当前多模态上下文检索相关记忆，并动态融合这些 LoRA 参数来生成 action chunk。方法是 plug-and-play，可挂在多个 VLA backbone 上。
summary.experiments: 在 RoboTwin、RLBench 和真实机器人操作任务上评估；摘要称多个 backbone 均有提升，仿真中最高达到 207% 相对提升，真实场景成功率也提高，但未给出完整模型规模和绝对数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve cross-task generalization in Vision-Language-Action models for unseen robotic manipulation tasks requiring transfer of object, scene, and action experience.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time procedural-memory transfer mechanism for VLA models. It is not a direct pretraining result, but it is relevant to parametric memory, adapter routing, and modular composition.
summary_en.technical_approach: VLA-Pro stores task-specific LoRA adapters during training as parameterized procedural memories. At inference time, it retrieves memories using the current multimodal context and dynamically fuses the selected adapters to generate the action chunk.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on RoboTwin, RLBench, and real-world manipulation tasks. The abstract reports consistent gains across multiple backbones, with up to 207% relative improvement in simulation and improved real-world success rates, but full absolute metrics and model sizes are not provided.

recommendation.zh: 只看记忆检索和 LoRA 融合设计；机器人结果不必深读，但这个 adapter-as-memory 设定可借鉴到工具和多模态持续学习。
recommendation.en: Skim the retrieval and LoRA-fusion design; the robotics results are secondary, but adapter-as-memory is reusable for tool use and multimodal continual learning.

paper.title: RoboWits: Unexpected Challenges for Robotic Creative Problem Solving
paper.abstract: The ability to reason, adapt, and creatively solve problems under unexpected challenges is essential for robots operating in real-world environments. However, current robotic benchmarks primarily emphasize skill-level execution and provide limited insight into such cognitive reasoning capabilities. We introduce RoboWits, a bi-manual robotic benchmark designed to systematically evaluate cognitive reasoning, creative tool use, and robustness to unexpected conditions. To enable scalable constructio

summary.core_problem: 论文提出 RoboWits，用来评测机器人在双臂操作中遇到意外条件时的推理、工具使用和策略调整能力，而不是只评测抓取、推动、放置等低层技能。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不是 LLM 预训练论文，和基座模型训练的关系较远。可取之处在于它把 VLA 和 VLM planner 的失败模式从“动作执行不稳”拆到“物理约束、材料属性、几何关系、装配关系推理不足”。对通用 agent 或具身多模态模型研究有一定参考价值，尤其是 benchmark 设计和自动任务生成流程。对纯文本 LLM pretrain 的信息增益有限。
summary.technical_approach: RoboWits 的任务定义包含自然语言目标、物体列表、三维场景配置、可执行评测指标和难度分数。指令只说明目标，不提示解法，例如只要求“夹起银行卡”，不说明需要先推到桌边再夹取。任务覆盖几何、材料和装配类推理，并通过小幅场景变化阻断原始解法，迫使模型调整策略。数据构建部分采用 multi-agent pipeline：seed task generator 生成初始任务，mutation generator 生成变体，metric generator 生成可执行评测指标，verifier 检查可行性和是否确实需要推理，scene generator 构建物理一致的场景。这个设计的重点是降低人工设计复杂机器人推理任务的成本。
summary.experiments: 基准包含 30 个 seed tasks，并扩展到 208 个任务，按 1 到 5 的难度分级；作者还为 10 个 seed tasks 收集了 50 条人类遥操作示范。实验评测了 imitation learning baseline、预训练 VLA 模型、以及带 oracle object state 的 VLM planner，并覆盖单任务微调和多任务学习设置。主要结论是：预训练 VLA 在低数据设置下优于从零训练模型，但在材料交互和装配推理上仍明显困难；即使 VLM planner 拿到 oracle 状态，在原始 seed task 上可以取得较合理表现，但对 mutation task 的泛化较弱。这说明当前具身模型的瓶颈不只是视觉识别或动作控制，也包括对约束变化的策略重构。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 15 到 25 分钟。建议重点看 benchmark 设计、任务生成 pipeline、以及 seed task 和 mutation task 的性能差异。对 LLM 基座研究员来说，最有用的是自动构造评测任务的流程，以及“只改一点场景就让原策略失效”的评测思想。机器人控制细节和具体仿真环境实现可以快速略过。

summary_en.core_problem: RoboWits is a benchmark for testing whether robotic agents can reason, adapt, and use tools creatively under unexpected physical constraints, rather than only executing well-specified manipulation skills.
summary_en.importance: This is not a language-model pretraining paper, and its direct relevance to base-model training is limited. Its value lies in the evaluation design for embodied multimodal agents. The benchmark separates low-level manipulation competence from higher-level reasoning over geometry, material properties, physical constraints, and assembly structure. That makes it useful for diagnosing VLA and VLM-planner failures, but only indirectly useful for LLM pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each RoboWits task is specified by a natural-language instruction, object list, 3D scene configuration, executable metric, and difficulty score. The instruction states the goal without revealing the solution, so the agent has to infer a feasible strategy. The tasks cover geometric reasoning, material reasoning, and assembly-level reasoning. A central design choice is mutation: small scene changes invalidate the original solution path, forcing strategy adaptation. To scale task creation, the authors use a multi-agent generation pipeline with specialized agents for seed task generation, task mutation, metric generation, task verification, and scene generation. The verifier checks feasibility, simulatability, and whether reasoning is actually required.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 30 seed tasks expanded into 208 tasks with graded difficulty, plus 50 human teleoperation demonstrations for 10 seed tasks. The evaluation covers imitation-learning baselines, pretrained Vision-Language-Action models, and VLM-based planners with oracle access to object states, under both single-task fine-tuning and multi-task learning. The main finding is that pretrained VLAs help in low-data regimes, but still struggle with complex material interactions and assembly reasoning. VLM planners with oracle state can perform reasonably on seed tasks but generalize poorly to mutated variants, suggesting that current systems often fail at constraint-aware replanning rather than only at perception or control.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Read the benchmark construction section, the multi-agent task-generation pipeline, and the comparison between seed tasks and mutated tasks. For base-model researchers, the most transferable idea is the evaluation pattern: perturb the scene just enough to break a memorized or default solution, then measure whether the agent can infer a new strategy. Low-level simulation and robot-control details can be read lightly.

recommendation.zh: 看任务生成 pipeline 和失败类型即可；它是 VLA 评测信号，不是预训练 recipe 信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the task-generation pipeline and failure taxonomy; this is a VLA evaluation signal, not a pretraining-recipe signal.

paper.title: Rethinking VLM Representation for VLA Initialization
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models widely adopt pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as policy backbones, yet it remains unclear what kind of pretrained VLM representation is useful as a VLA initialization. In this paper, we study VLA initialization as a controlled representation-design problem along three axes: capability-level embodied VQA supervision, parameter-update strategy, and robot-data pretraining. Our experiments show that the original pretrained VLM representation is a key sourc

summary.core_problem: 研究什么样的预训练 VLM 表示适合作为 Vision-Language-Action 模型的初始化，而不是默认把 VLM finetune 成策略网络。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是表示迁移分析。它把 VLA 初始化拆成三个可控因素：具身 VQA 监督、参数更新策略、机器人数据预训练；对理解 VLM 表示如何迁移到行动模型有参考价值，但离 LLM 基座预训练仍有一层任务适配距离。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将 VLA 初始化设为受控 representation-design 问题，比较原始预训练 VLM 表示、具身 VQA 适配、LoRA 与 full finetune 等更新策略，以及机器人数据预训练。核心观察是保留原始 VLM 表示很关键，LoRA 比全量微调更稳，机器人数据预训练进一步改善初始化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、具体 VLM/VLA backbone、机器人数据规模或数值提升；披露的实验结论包括：具身 VQA 适配收益依赖下游瓶颈，不同能力域收益不简单相加；LoRA 初始化可靠性优于 full finetune；分阶段 LoRA 机器人数据预训练得到最强变体。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies which pretrained VLM representations are useful for initializing Vision-Language-Action models, instead of assuming that any VLM adaptation will improve policy learning.
summary_en.importance: This is a representation-transfer analysis. It decomposes VLA initialization into embodied VQA supervision, parameter-update strategy, and robot-data pretraining. The findings are relevant to how pretrained VLM features transfer into action models, though the connection to LLM foundation pretraining is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors frame VLA initialization as a controlled representation-design problem. They compare the original pretrained VLM representation, embodied VQA adaptation, LoRA versus full finetuning, and robot-data pretraining. The central message is that preserving the pretrained representation matters, LoRA is more reliable than full finetuning, and staged LoRA-based robot-data pretraining works best among the studied variants.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, exact VLM/VLA backbones, robot-data scale, or quantitative gains. It reports qualitative findings: embodied VQA adaptation is bottleneck-dependent and non-additive across capability domains; LoRA is a more reliable initialization than full finetuning; robot-data pretraining further improves VLA initialization.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验分解和 LoRA-vs-full finetune 结果；它提醒预训练表示被过度重塑会伤迁移，但证据还偏机器人场景。
recommendation.en: Read only the factorized experiments and LoRA-vs-full-finetune result; the useful signal is that over-reshaping pretrained representations can hurt transfer, though the evidence is robotics-bound.

paper.title: PointACT: Vision-Language-Action Models with Multi-Scale Point-Action Interaction
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation by leveraging large pretrained vision-language backbones. However, most existing VLAs rely primarily on 2D visual representations, which limit their ability to reason about fine-grained geometry and spatial grounding - capabilities that are essential for precise and robust manipulation in 3D environments. In this paper, we propose PointACT, a dual-system 3D-aware VLA policy that integrates hi

summary.core_problem: 现有视觉语言动作(VLA)模型依赖2D视觉表示，无法精细推理3D几何与空间定位，限制了机器人操纵的精度与鲁棒性
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将分层3D点云表示直接集成到动作解码过程的双系统VLA架构
summary.technical_approach: 提出PointACT双系统3D感知VLA策略，采用多尺度点-动作交互机制与高效瓶颈窗口自注意力，使动作token可同时关注局部几何细节与全局场景结构
summary.experiments: 在LIBERO和RLBench机器人操纵基准上测试，与多种单/双系统VLA基线（含增强点云输入的变体）做系统对比，摘要未披露具体提升幅度
summary.authors_note: Inria、巴黎高师等机构，Cordelia Schmid是知名计算机视觉学者，长期从事多模态与视觉表示研究

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely on 2D visual representations and cannot reason about fine-grained 3D geometry and spatial grounding, limiting robotic manipulation precision and robustness.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first dual-system VLA architecture that integrates hierarchical 3D point cloud representations directly into action decoding.
summary_en.technical_approach: PointACT is a dual-system 3D-aware VLA policy with multi-scale point-action interaction and efficient bottleneck window self-attention, enabling action tokens to attend to both local geometric details and global scene structure.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LIBERO and RLBench robotic manipulation benchmarks, systematically compared against monolithic and dual-system VLA baselines including point-cloud-augmented variants; exact performance gains are not disclosed in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Researchers from Inria, École Normale Supérieure, etc. Cordelia Schmid is a prominent computer vision researcher focused on multimodal and visual representation learning.

recommendation.en: Architectural improvement for robotic VLA, only relevant for multimodal robotic agent researchers, no direct connection to LLM foundation pretraining.
