paper.title: Rethinking Muon Beyond Pretraining: Spectral Failures and High-Pass Remedies for VLA and RLVR
paper.abstract: Muon is a matrix-aware optimizer that leverages Newton-Schulz (NS) iterations to enforce spectral gradient orthogonalization by driving all singular values of the momentum matrix toward 1. While this uniform spectral whitening enhances exploration and outperforms AdamW in LLM pretraining, we show it could lead to fundamental limitations beyond pretraining in two regimes: (i) cross-modality vision-language-action (VLA) training, where inherently low-rank action-module gradients cause amplificatio

summary.core_problem: 矩阵感知优化器Muon在LLM预训练中表现优于AdamW，但其核心的统一谱白化机制会将动量矩阵的所有奇异值推向1，在预训练之外的两个关键场景存在本质缺陷：1）跨模态视觉-语言-动作（VLA）训练中，动作模块梯度本身低秩，尾部分量以噪声为主，Muon会放大这些噪声方向；2）带可验证奖励的强化学习后训练（RLVR）中，梯度信噪比低且需要保留预训练习得的注意力头分工，统一白化会导致更新不稳定。现有低秩Muon变体依赖固定秩截断和额外SVD/随机投影开销，无法适配不同层和训练阶段的动态需求。
summary.importance: 首次系统揭示了Muon类矩阵优化器在预训练后场景的谱特性缺陷，提出的Pion优化器可直接作为Muon的 drop-in 替换，计算开销与Muon完全一致，在多模态和RL后训练场景均取得稳定收益，为大模型全链路训练（预训练→多模态适配→RL对齐）的优化器选型和设计提供了核心依据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Pion（动量谱高通优化器），核心是利用Newton-Schulz（NS）迭代的多项式结构，将Muon的单阶段谱白化改造为两阶段的Promotion+Suppression多项式映射（高通NS）：首先放大主导奇异值，再抑制尾部奇异值，形成软高通滤波器，将前导有效奇异值锚定在1的同时把噪声尾部推向0，每步计算开销与Muon完全相同。进一步引入分头模式，将注意力投影矩阵按头维度拆分，对每个头独立执行高通NS迭代，适配不同注意力头的更新尺度差异，无额外计算开销。
summary.experiments: 在VLA任务上，基于π0.5骨干模型，在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus数据集和真实Franka机器人平台上，带ℓ1回归和流匹配头的训练中，Pion效果超过AdamW和Muon；在RLVR任务上，基于Qwen3-1.7B/4B模型，使用GRPO、GMPO算法在MATH和GSM8K数据集上，Pion同样稳定优于AdamW和Muon，同时保持与Muon相同的计算效率。消融实验验证了高通NS和分头模式的各自贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2章对Muon谱缺陷的分析、第3章Pion的高通NS设计，以及第4章的VLA和RLVR实验对比，附录中的多项式系数推导细节可深入参考。核心创新点在于利用NS迭代的多项式结构实现无额外开销的谱高通滤波，而非依赖SVD等重计算操作。值得深挖的方向包括将高通NS机制适配到预训练场景，以及针对不同训练阶段动态调整高通滤波器的截止阈值。

summary_en.core_problem: The matrix-aware optimizer Muon outperforms AdamW in LLM pretraining, but its core uniform spectral whitening mechanism that pushes all singular values of the momentum matrix to 1 has fundamental limitations in two critical post-pretraining regimes: 1) Cross-modality Vision-Language-Action (VLA) training, where action module gradients are inherently low-rank with noise-dominated tail components, which Muon amplifies; 2) Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) post-training, where gradients have low SNR and attention head specialization inherited from pretraining needs to be preserved, making uniform whitening unstable. Existing low-rank Muon variants rely on fixed-rank truncation and extra SVD/random projection overhead, and cannot adapt to dynamic requirements across layers and training steps.
summary_en.importance: First systematically reveals the spectral limitations of Muon-style matrix optimizers in post-pretraining scenarios. The proposed Pion optimizer is a direct drop-in replacement for Muon with identical computational cost, delivering consistent gains in both multimodal and RL post-training. It provides core guidance for optimizer selection and design across the full LLM training pipeline: pretraining → multimodal adaptation → RL alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Pion (Spectral High-pass Optimization on Momentum). Leveraging the polynomial structure of Newton-Schulz (NS) iteration, it reformulates Muon's single-stage spectral whitening into a two-stage Promotion+Suppression polynomial map (high-pass NS): it first amplifies dominant singular values, then suppresses tail components, forming a soft high-pass filter that anchors informative leading singular values at 1 while driving noisy tails toward 0, with identical per-step computational cost as Muon. A per-head mode is further introduced, which splits attention projection matrices along the head dimension and runs high-pass NS iteration independently for each head, adapting to heterogeneous update scales across attention heads with no additional overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On VLA tasks with π0.5 backbone, Pion outperforms AdamW and Muon on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus datasets and real Franka robot setups with ℓ1 regression and flow-matching heads. On RLVR tasks with Qwen3-1.7B/4B using GRPO and GMPO algorithms on MATH and GSM8K, Pion also consistently outperforms AdamW and Muon while matching Muon's computational efficiency. Ablation studies verify the individual contributions of high-pass NS and per-head mode.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for analysis of Muon's spectral defects, Section 3 for Pion's high-pass NS design, and Section 4 for VLA and RLVR experimental comparisons. Refer to the appendix for polynomial coefficient derivation details. The core innovation is leveraging the polynomial structure of NS iteration to achieve overhead-free spectral high-pass filtering, instead of relying on expensive operations like SVD. Worthwhile follow-up directions include adapting the high-pass NS mechanism to pretraining scenarios, and dynamically adjusting the high-pass filter cutoff threshold across training stages.

recommendation.zh: Muon 不能直接平移到 RLVR/VLA；应优先看谱分析和 Pion ablation，内部后训练优化器实验值得复现。
recommendation.en: Muon does not transfer cleanly to RLVR/VLA; read the spectral analysis and Pion ablations, then reproduce the optimizer swap internally.

paper.title: Learn Where Outcomes Diverge: Efficient VLA RL via Probabilistic Chunk Masking
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) allows vision-language-action (VLA) policies to generalize beyond their training distribution by optimizing directly for task success, but post-training is computationally expensive. A natural response has been to speed rollout collection through faster simulators and world models. In GRPO-based VLA RL, we find that the dominant cost lies elsewhere: gradient computation accounts for approximately 78% of wall-clock time per step in our runs, while rollout collection ac

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决的是 VLA 的 GRPO 强化学习后训练效率问题。关键观察是，瓶颈不一定在 rollout 采样，而在 actor 更新的前后向计算。作者在自己的运行中测到，单步 wall-clock 中约 78% 花在梯度计算，约 21% 花在 rollout collection。问题因此变成：一条轨迹里的哪些 action chunk 值得参与反向传播，而不是默认对所有 chunk 都算梯度。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性不强，但对大模型后训练的 compute allocation 有启发。它把 RL 训练中的样本效率问题转成了梯度预算分配问题：不是只改 advantage 或 reward，而是减少无信息阶段的反向传播。这个视角对语言模型 RL、长轨迹 agent RL、tool-use RL 也有可迁移性，尤其是当奖励是 trajectory-level、有效 credit 只集中在少数决策点时。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Probabilistic Chunk Masking，作为 GRPO 的插拔式改造。轨迹先被切成 action chunks，并用确定性规则分到若干 semantic phases。普通 GRPO 会给同一条轨迹里的所有 chunk 分配同一个 group-relative advantage，并对所有 chunk 做反向传播。PCM 只保留固定预算内的 chunk 参与 actor update，未选中的 chunk 被物理移出 backward path，从而同时省计算和 activation memory。保留概率不是均匀采样，而是按 phase 的 outcome divergence 来分配。理论上，作者把每个 phase 的有效学习信号定义为 per-phase gradient variance V_c，并给出类似 Neyman allocation 的预算分配，比例为 N_c sqrt(V_c)。由于 V_c 不能直接低成本获得，作者用成功 rollout 与失败 rollout 在该 phase 上的 action variance C_c 作为代理，并证明 C_c 可作为 V_c 的可测 lower-bound proxy。这个设计区别于 PPO critic 或 per-step credit assignment：后者主要改变学习信号，PCM 改变哪些位置获得梯度计算。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 LIBERO VLA 任务上。作者报告 PCM 使用每条轨迹少于 20% 的 chunks，达到 98% convergence 的 wall-clock 时间加速 2.38 倍，梯度步骤本身加速 4.8 倍，peak activation memory 降低 60%。这些数字支持一个核心结论：在该设置里，减少 backward 覆盖范围比继续优化 rollout 采样更有效。消融重点应是 phase-level variance 是否真的集中、C_c 与真实梯度方差 V_c 的相关性、固定预算下按 C_c 分配是否优于 uniform masking 或随机 chunk masking。给出的正文片段表明作者强调 outcome-critical semantic phases 的稀疏性，但完整实验表中的任务级成功率、不同 chunk budget、不同 phase labeling 规则的鲁棒性需要进一步核对。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 里的 cost breakdown，确认 78% 梯度计算占比是否来自目标运行设置；再看 Methodology 中 V_c、C_c 和 Neyman allocation 的定义，重点理解为什么 action variance 能作为 gradient variance 的代理；最后看 LIBERO 实验中的 chunk budget、收敛曲线、memory 曲线和 masking 消融。若关心 LLM RL，可重点抽象出一个问题：长轨迹中哪些 token 或 action step 应该进入 backward，而不仅是如何给所有 token 分配 advantage。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets the training cost of GRPO-based reinforcement learning for vision-language-action policies. Its main observation is that rollout collection is not the dominant bottleneck in the authors’ setup. Gradient computation accounts for about 78% of per-step wall-clock time, while rollout collection accounts for about 21%. The practical question is therefore which chunks inside a trajectory should receive backpropagation, rather than assuming that every chunk deserves gradient compute.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core LLM pretraining contribution, but it gives a useful compute-allocation view for large-model RL. It treats gradient computation as a scarce resource and allocates it to trajectory segments where success and failure actually diverge. This is relevant beyond robotics: long-horizon language-agent RL, tool-use training, and trajectory-level reward optimization often have sparse decision points, while standard policy-gradient implementations still backpropagate through many low-signal tokens or steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Probabilistic Chunk Masking, is a drop-in modification to chunk-level GRPO. A trajectory is divided into action chunks, and chunks are assigned to deterministic semantic phases. Standard GRPO applies the same group-relative advantage across all chunks in a trajectory and computes gradients everywhere. PCM instead keeps only a fixed budget of chunks and physically removes the rest from the backward pass. The keep probability is phase-dependent. The paper defines the useful signal of a phase as its per-phase gradient variance V_c and derives a Neyman-style allocation proportional to N_c sqrt(V_c). Since V_c is expensive to measure directly, PCM uses the action variance between successful and failed rollouts, C_c, as a measurable proxy. The authors argue and prove that C_c lower-bounds the relevant gradient-variance signal under their assumptions. The key distinction from critic-based credit assignment is that PCM changes compute placement, not only the scalar learning signal.
summary_en.experiments: The main reported evaluation is on LIBERO. PCM uses less than 20% of trajectory chunks, reaches 98% convergence with a 2.38x wall-clock speedup, makes gradient steps 4.8x faster, and reduces peak activation memory by 60%. These results support the claim that, in this VLA RL regime, actor-update compute is the right target for optimization. The most informative ablations are the concentration of phase-level variance, the quality of C_c as a proxy for V_c, and comparisons against uniform or random chunk masking under the same chunk budget. The supplied text does not expose all task-level tables, so final confidence should depend on how robust the gains are across tasks, budgets, and phase-labeling rules.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Start with the cost breakdown in the introduction, because the method is only compelling if gradient computation is indeed the dominant cost. Then read the definitions of V_c, C_c, and the Neyman allocation in the methodology. Finally inspect the LIBERO convergence curves, memory measurements, and masking ablations. For LLM RL readers, the transferable idea is selective backpropagation over long trajectories, rather than another variant of advantage normalization.

recommendation.zh: 建议看 profiling 和 masking 规则：78% 梯度开销这个数会改变 VLA RL 优化优先级，但需警惕任务规模是否偏小。
recommendation.en: Read the profiling and masking rule: the 78% gradient-cost number changes VLA RL optimization priorities, though task scale may be the weak point.

paper.title: RotVLA: Rotational Latent Action for Vision-Language-Action Model
paper.abstract: Latent Action Models (LAMs) have emerged as an effective paradigm for handling heterogeneous datasets during Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model pretraining, offering a unified action space across embodiments. However, existing LAMs often rely on discrete quantization encode and decode pipelines, which can lead to trivial frame reconstruction behavior, limited representational capacity, and a lack of physically meaningful structure. We introduce RotVLA, a VLA framework built on a continuous rotat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 VLA 预训练里一个很具体但关键的问题：如何从异构机器人数据和无标注人类视频中学到一个统一、可迁移、又不容易退化的 latent action 空间。现有 LAM 多数走“相邻帧编码→离散量化→重建下一帧”的路线，优点是容易接到 token-based VLM，但缺点也很集中：一是 latent 容易退化成对目标帧的压缩编码，而不是动作；二是离散 codebook 对连续物理动作的表达不自然，容量也受限；三是 latent 空间缺少可组合的几何结构，难以承载跨 embodiment 的动作语义。RotVLA 的核心问题定义得很清楚：不用离散 token action，而是构造一个连续、可组合、带几何约束的 latent action 表示，并让它更像“动力学中的动作”而不是“重建中的捷径变量”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接启发不在于机器人结果本身，而在于它给出了一种替代离散 latent token 的思路：把中间动作表示放到一个有结构的连续流形上，再通过组合约束去抑制 shortcut learning。这个方向和语言/多模态预训练里几个长期问题是相通的：第一，离散化是否真是统一建模的必要条件；第二，如何给 latent 变量加入物理或群结构，而不是只靠 reconstruction loss；第三，如何让中间表示具备组合性，从而支持 zero-shot 迁移。贡献量级更像“有想法的方法论文”，不是会立刻改写通用 LLM 预训练范式的工作，但对连续 latent modeling、structured representation、以及 AR token 范式之外的预训练设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两层。第一层是 rotational latent action model。作者先保留 LAM 的基本 inverse/forward dynamics 框架，但把传统 VQ-VAE 式硬量化换成 SoftVQ，用软分配保留 codebook 结构，同时避免完全离散化带来的不连续。进一步，latent action 不再是任意向量，而被约束为 SO(n) 上的旋转矩阵。实现上不是直接让网络输出正交矩阵，因为那样约束太硬、表达能力不足；模型先输出一个非约束矩阵 M，再做 SVD 分解 M=UΣV^T，并通过正交投影得到最接近的 rotation matrix。这样做的取舍很明确：训练时保留自由度，表示层再投影到群结构上。

第二层是 triplet frame learning。作者不用传统两帧重建，而是取三帧 I_t, I_{t+1}, I_{t+2}（文中也允许更一般的 first-second-third transition），分别编码前两段转移，再利用 SO(n) 的闭包性用矩阵乘法组合两个 latent action，去监督从第一帧到第三帧的 latent action。这个设计的关键不是多看一帧，而是把“动作可组合”写进训练目标里。若 latent 只是目标帧压缩码，组合关系通常不成立；只有当它更接近真实 transition factor 时，这个约束才容易满足。因此 triplet objective 实际上是在用代数结构压制 trivial reconstruction shortcut。

在 VLA 部分，作者把预训练好的 latent action model 接到一个 VLM backbone 上，用 flow-matching latent action head 预测连续 latent action，而不是做离散 token 分类。下游微调时，再把 action head 扩展成 unified flow-matching action head，同时建模 latent action 和 robot action，并通过 causal attention 让 robot action 生成条件化在 latent action 上。这里 latent action 被当作 planner，robot action 是 embodiment-specific executor。这个分层设计解释了为什么它能做 cross-embodiment 迁移：先在共享 latent 层对齐，再在具体动作层适配。
summary.experiments:
文中给出的主结果是：1.7B 参数的 RotVLA 在 LIBERO 上达到 98.2%，在 RoboTwin2.0 上达到 89.6% / 88.5%，并报告了真实机器人 pick-and-place、cup stacking 等任务上的优于已有 VLA 方法的表现。就 digest 视角，最该关注的不是绝对分数，而是几组验证其设计动机的实验。

第一类是 latent 表示设计的消融：离散 latent、连续但无旋转约束、以及带 SO(n) 约束的版本之间的比较。如果正文完整实验与引言表述一致，那么作者想证明三件事：SoftVQ 比硬量化更适合连续动作；SO(n) 约束提升组合性和跨 embodiment 泛化；triplet learning 比单纯 frame reconstruction 更能避免退化。第二类是预训练数据来源的消融，即人类视频与跨 embodiment 机器人数据是否互补。按方法设定，前者主要提供通用视觉-动作动态先验，后者提供可落到机器人控制空间的桥梁。第三类是下游 action head 的消融，即是否真的需要 unified flow-matching head 与 latent-as-planner 结构，而不是直接从视觉语言上下文回归机器人动作。

从已给出的数字看，1.7B 规模做到接近 98% 的 LIBERO 成功率，说明方法在标准仿真基准上是有效的；RoboTwin2.0 的双指标 89.6/88.5 也表明它在更强调跨 embodiment 或双臂/双场景泛化的设定下没有明显塌陷。若要判断结果是否扎实，需要重点看：与哪些 VLA/LAM baseline 比；训练数据规模是否对齐；真实机器人实验是否只挑选少量友好任务；以及 zero-shot latent action generation 的定义是否严格。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读，不建议逐式子深抠全部细节。优先看 Introduction 和方法总图，先确认作者到底在替换 LAM 的哪一层。然后看 rotational latent action 那一节，重点理解两件事：为什么用 SO(n) 而不是一般连续向量空间；为什么采用“先输出 unconstrained matrix，再 SVD 投影”的实现。接着看 triplet frame learning，对照 Fig.2 理解它如何抑制 trivial reconstruction。实验部分建议重点看三类表：latent 表示消融、triplet objective 消融、以及下游 VLA 微调结构消融。若时间有限，30-40 分钟足够抓住主线；若要深挖，值得追问的是 SO(n) 是否只是一个方便的结构先验，还是确实对应了动作动力学中的可解释变量，以及 flow matching 在这里相比 diffusion/直接回归到底带来了什么稳定性或多模态收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in VLA pretraining: how to learn a unified latent action space from heterogeneous robot data and unlabeled human videos without collapsing into frame reconstruction shortcuts. Most prior latent action models use an encode-quantize-decode pipeline, which fits token-based VLM training but creates three issues: the latent can degenerate into a compressed code for the target frame, discrete codebooks are a poor fit for continuous physical actions, and the latent space lacks a meaningful compositional structure. RotVLA reframes the problem as learning a continuous, structured latent action that behaves like a transition variable rather than a reconstruction artifact.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is less about robotics alone and more about representation design. The paper is a concrete example of replacing discrete latent tokens with a continuous manifold-constrained latent space, then using composition constraints to suppress shortcut learning. That connects to broader pretraining questions: whether discretization is truly necessary for unified modeling, how to inject geometry or group structure into latent variables, and how to make intermediate representations compositional enough for transfer. This is not a paradigm-shifting result for general LLM pretraining, but it is a useful method paper for anyone thinking about structured continuous latents beyond autoregressive token prediction.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two layers. First is the rotational latent action model. The authors keep the inverse-dynamics / forward-dynamics skeleton of latent action models, but replace hard VQ-style quantization with SoftVQ so the latent remains codebook-structured yet continuous. They then constrain the latent action to live on SO(n), representing each action as an n-by-n rotation matrix. Instead of forcing the network to directly output an orthogonal matrix, which would be too restrictive, the model predicts an unconstrained matrix M, computes its SVD M = UΣV^T, and projects it to the nearest rotation matrix. This is a practical compromise: expressive learning dynamics first, geometric structure at the representation layer.

Second is triplet frame learning. Rather than supervising only pairwise reconstruction, the model uses three frames and encodes two consecutive transitions. Because SO(n) is closed under matrix multiplication, the two latent actions can be composed to predict the latent action from the first frame to the third. This is the key idea. The objective does not merely add another frame; it writes compositionality directly into training. If the latent is just a hidden code for the target frame, the composition relation will usually fail. If it captures transition dynamics, the relation becomes natural. In that sense, the triplet objective is a structural regularizer against trivial reconstruction solutions.

On top of the pretrained latent action model, RotVLA attaches a VLM backbone with a flow-matching latent action head to predict continuous latent actions instead of discrete action tokens. During downstream adaptation, the head is extended into a unified flow-matching action head that denoises both latent actions and robot actions. Robot action generation is causally conditioned on latent actions, so the latent space acts as a planner while the robot action head acts as an embodiment-specific executor. That decomposition explains the intended cross-embodiment generalization behavior.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline numbers are a 1.7B-parameter model reaching 98.2% on LIBERO and 89.6% / 88.5% on RoboTwin2.0, plus real-robot gains on tasks such as pick-and-place and cup stacking. For a research reader, the more important part is whether the experiments validate the design choices.

The first set to inspect is the latent representation ablation: discrete latent actions, continuous latents without rotational structure, and SO(n)-constrained latents. The intended claim is that SoftVQ is better than hard quantization for continuous action modeling, SO(n) improves compositionality and cross-embodiment transfer, and triplet learning reduces degeneracy relative to plain frame reconstruction. The second set is data-source ablation: how human videos and cross-embodiment robot data complement each other. The method suggests that human videos provide generic visual-dynamics priors, while robot data anchors the latent space to controllable action semantics. The third set is the downstream action-head ablation: whether the unified flow-matching head and latent-as-planner design actually outperform direct robot-action regression from vision-language context.

The reported benchmark numbers indicate the method is competitive at moderate scale, but the real question is robustness: which VLA/LAM baselines are used, whether training data are matched, how strict the zero-shot setting is, and whether the real-robot evaluation is broad or selectively chosen.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper rather than a line-by-line derivation paper. Start with the introduction and the overview figures to pin down exactly which part of the standard LAM pipeline is being replaced. Then read the rotational latent action section carefully, focusing on two choices: why SO(n) instead of a generic continuous latent vector, and why the model predicts an unconstrained matrix before SVD projection. After that, read the triplet frame learning section with the figure in view; that is where the anti-shortcut mechanism really lives. In experiments, prioritize the ablations on latent design, the triplet objective, and the downstream action head. Around 30 to 40 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. If you want to go deeper, the useful questions are whether SO(n) is merely a convenient inductive bias or a genuinely interpretable action geometry, and whether flow matching brings a real optimization or multimodality advantage over diffusion or direct regression here.

paper.title: AttenA+: Rectifying Action Inequality in Robotic Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Existing robotic foundation models, while powerful, are predicated on an implicit assumption of temporal homogeneity: treating all actions as equally informative during optimization. This "flat" training paradigm, inherited from language modeling, remains indifferent to the underlying physical hierarchy of manipulation. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论机器人基础模型中的 action token 训练权重问题。现有 VLA 和 World-Action Model 通常对轨迹中每个动作步使用相同 loss 权重，但真实操作轨迹并不均匀：快速移动多是容错的过渡段，慢速接触、对齐、抓取和放置阶段更容易决定任务成败。
summary.importance: 这不是通用 LLM 预训练论文，但对跨模态统一建模有一个清晰启发：非文本 token 不一定适合沿用语言建模里的均匀 token loss。对 action、audio、video 这类带物理时间结构的序列，token 的训练权重可能应该由模态内的物理先验决定。AttenA+ 给了一个简单例子：用末端执行器速度作为无需标注的关键性 proxy，把优化预算更多放在精细操作片段上。
summary.technical_approach: AttenA+ 是一个不改模型结构的 loss reweighting 框架。它先从专家轨迹中计算每个 timestep 的动作速度，速度可以来自平移维度、旋转维度，或二者组合。核心假设是速度越低，动作越可能处在接触丰富、精度要求高的阶段，因此每步 loss 的权重应随速度降低而增大。这个权重可以乘到不同训练目标上：回归式 VLA 的 L1/L2 action loss，diffusion policy 的 score-matching loss，或 flow matching 模型的 vector-field loss。方法的优点是参数量不变，数据不需要额外人工标注，主要引入的是一个物理先验驱动的优化重排。
summary.experiments: 论文在 Libero 和 RoboTwin 上评估，并在 Franka 机械臂上做真实环境验证。报告的主要现象是：AttenA+ 能提高长程操作和精细接触阶段的成功率，标准均匀 loss baseline 更容易在最后几厘米的对齐、抓取或放置阶段失败。提供的正文片段没有包含完整表格和具体提升数字，因此数值结论需要在实验章节中核对，尤其是不同 backbone、不同任务长度、以及低速片段加权强度的消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15 到 20 分钟。先看 Figure 2 的速度分布和任务阶段对应关系，确认“低速等于高关键性”这个假设是否在数据上站得住。再看方法部分的权重函数、归一化和是否有 clipping，因为这些细节决定训练是否会过度偏向静止或近静止动作。实验部分重点看三个消融：均匀 loss 对比速度加权、不同 VLA/WAM backbone 的迁移性、真实机器人上精细操作阶段的失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies loss weighting for action sequences in robotic foundation models. Current VLA and world-action models often train with a flat per-timestep objective, treating all action tokens as equally important. Manipulation trajectories are not uniform: fast motions are often transitional and tolerant to error, while slow contact-rich phases such as alignment, grasping, and placement tend to determine task success.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core text-LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to unified multimodal pretraining. It makes a concrete point that non-text tokens may not deserve the uniform loss treatment inherited from language modeling. For action, audio, and video tokens with physical temporal structure, token importance can be shaped by modality-specific signals. AttenA+ uses end-effector velocity as an annotation-free proxy for action criticality and reallocates optimization pressure toward precision-sensitive segments.
summary_en.technical_approach: AttenA+ is a plug-in loss reweighting method. It computes the instantaneous velocity of the ground-truth action at each timestep, using translational dimensions, rotational dimensions, or both. The training loss at each step is then multiplied by a velocity-derived weight, with lower-velocity actions receiving higher emphasis. The same idea can be applied to regression-based VLA objectives, diffusion-policy score-matching losses, and flow-matching vector-field losses. The method does not require architectural changes or extra parameters; it changes the optimization objective by injecting a simple kinematic prior.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers Libero and RoboTwin, with additional real-world experiments on a Franka manipulator. The reported pattern is that velocity-weighted training improves success in long-horizon manipulation and especially in precision-critical phases, where uniformly weighted baselines often fail near final alignment, grasp, or placement. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so exact gains, backbone-specific behavior, and weighting-strength ablations should be checked in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15- to 20-minute skim is sufficient. Start with the velocity analysis around Figure 2 to judge whether low velocity reliably corresponds to high manipulation criticality. Then inspect the weighting formula, normalization, and any clipping or smoothing details, since these determine whether the method overweights stationary actions. In the experiments, focus on uniform-loss comparisons, transfer across different robotic backbones, and real-robot failure cases in the last-centimeter phase.

recommendation.zh: 读 loss weighting 和 ablation；它把“语言式均匀 token loss”在动作模态上的失配讲清楚，值得做内部 sanity check。
recommendation.en: Read the loss weighting and ablations; it cleanly exposes where language-style uniform token loss mismatches action modalities and deserves an internal sanity check.

However, while using imagined trajectories reduces the sample complexity of policy training, existing methods still heavily rely on task-specific data to fine-tune both the world and reward models, fundamentally limiting their scalability to unseen tasks. To overcome this, we argue that world a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的机器人策略优化，而是一个更具体、也更卡脖子的问题：如何在目标任务完全未参与世界模型训练的前提下，用冻结的 world model 和冻结的 reward source，对新任务做高数据效率的 VLA 后训练。现有基于 imagined rollout 的 VLA-RL 方法虽然减少了真实交互，但 world model 往往仍要用目标任务数据重训或微调，reward 也常依赖任务专用分类器、参考轨迹或人工设计信号，所以一旦任务变了，整套流程都要重新收集数据。RAW-Dream 把这个依赖拆开：world model 只学任务无关的物理动态，reward 由通用 VLM 对 imagined video + instruction 做零样本判定，目标任务只需要少量 demonstration 把 policy 对齐到任务语义，再在梦境里做 RL。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于它提出了一个新的 backbone，而在于它把“可复用的 task-agnostic simulator”明确成了一个预训练对象，并给出了一条比 task-specific world-model RL 更干净的扩展路线。这里有三个层面的价值。第一，它把 world model 的训练目标从“服务某个任务”改成“覆盖 embodiment 的物理先验”，这和基座模型预训练里追求 transferable prior 的思路是一致的。第二，它把 reward 从任务内监督中解耦出来，改用冻结 VLM 做 zero-shot success judgment，这相当于把通用视觉语义能力接到了 RL 后训练接口上。第三，它说明在 VLA 场景里，预训练和后训练的边界可以重新划分：world model 与 reward 准备一次，后续只适配 policy。这个范式如果成立，影响的是数据预算结构，而不只是单点指标提升。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三块。第一块是 task-agnostic action-conditioned video world model。作者基于 WAN 2.1 搭建动作条件视频生成器，但训练数据严格来自 broad-coverage、与下游任务无关的交互数据，例如 play data 或 benchmark 中不含目标任务的任务集合。关键点不是模型结构新，而是训练约束新：world model 不允许看 target-task rollout，因此它必须靠更广覆盖的行为分布去学可迁移的物理动力学，而不是记住任务模板。

第二块是 zero-shot reward。作者不训练任务专用 reward model，而是把 imagined rollout 视频和文本指令交给冻结的 Qwen3-VL，由其直接判断任务是否成功，输出二值奖励。这样 reward source 也不再依赖目标任务标注器。这里的取舍很清楚：牺牲一部分 reward 精细度，换取跨任务可复用性和零额外标注。

第三块是在 world model 内做 policy optimization。策略采用 OpenVLA-OFT，先用极少量 demonstration 做 SFT，把策略锚定到新任务语义；然后在冻结 world model 中用 GRPO 做 RL。由于 imagined rollout 在未见任务上更容易出现 hallucinated success，作者加了 dual-noise verification：对同一初始条件，用不同 diffusion noise 生成多条 rollout，只有当 VLM reward 在不同噪声下保持一致时，才把该奖励视为可信。这一步不是简单 ensemble，而是专门针对生成式 world model 的 reward hacking 问题：如果成功只在某个噪声样本里出现，往往说明是模型幻觉而非稳定可实现的轨迹。

从方法定位看，RAW-Dream 的创新不在单个组件，而在组合方式和约束设计。它没有重新发明 VLA、VLM 或 video diffusion WM，而是把三者放进一个严格 task-agnostic 的后训练闭环里，并补上了 hallucination-aware reward verification 这个必要环节。
summary.experiments:
实验分成仿真和真实机器人两部分。仿真上，作者在 LIBERO 上训练 world model 时只使用 LIBERO-90 数据，并把 Spatial、Object、Goal、Long 四个 held-out task suites 作为 world-model 训练时完全未见的下游任务。这个设定比常见的 imagined RL 更严格，因为不是同任务低样本，而是 world model 对目标任务零暴露。结果上，RAW-Dream 相比 1-shot SFT baseline 带来 +8.9% 的提升，并且优于需要 50× 更多真实世界数据的 online RL。这个对比很关键，它说明 task-agnostic WM + zero-shot reward 并不是只在“省数据但性能差一些”的角落里成立，而是在数据效率上有明显优势。

真实机器人上，world model 只用多样、未清洗的 play data 预训练，不看目标任务数据。每个新任务从 3-shot SFT 起步，再进入 imagined RL。最终成功率相对 3-shot SFT baseline 有 +21.7% 的绝对提升。对机器人场景来说，这个幅度已经足以说明 dream-based RL 不是纯粹的模拟器内自娱自乐，而是能把少量 demonstration 放大成可观的真实收益。

从文中叙述看，值得注意的消融主要有三类：一是验证 task-agnostic WM 相比 target-task-specific 方案在 unseen-task setting 下的适配能力；二是验证 VLM zero-shot reward 的可用性；三是 dual-noise verification 对抑制 hallucinated success 和 false-positive reward hacking 的作用。虽然给出的摘要片段没有完整表格数字，但论文主结论依赖的不是单一主表，而是这三类消融共同支撑：world model 要足够通用，reward 要足够稳，RL 才能在未见任务上真正工作。
summary.reading_guide:
精读时先抓三处。第一是 Introduction 里对问题设定的限定：不是一般的 world-model RL，而是“target-task-agnostic VLA-RL optimization in WMs”。这句话决定了整篇工作的评价标准。第二是 Method 里 world model、zero-shot VLM reward、GRPO、dual-noise verification 之间的接口设计，尤其要看 reward 是如何从 imagined video 中提取、如何做一致性过滤，以及 policy 更新时哪些模块冻结、哪些模块可训练。第三是实验部分关于 LIBERO held-out suites 和 real-robot play-data 预训练的设定，这些设定决定了结果是否真的说明了 transferable physical prior，而不是数据泄漏。

如果时间有限，优先看：任务设定图、整体 pipeline 图、LIBERO 主结果表、dual-noise verification 消融、真实机器人结果。若要深挖，建议重点想两个问题：一，task-agnostic world model 的能力边界到底由数据覆盖决定，还是由生成模型 fidelity 决定；二，VLM reward 在 imagined video 上的误判会不会形成系统性偏差，dual-noise 只是降噪还是已经足够构成可靠的 reward filter。阅读时间大约 45–70 分钟，若连附录中的实现细节和失败案例一起看，可能需要更久。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a specific bottleneck in world-model-based VLA post-training: how to improve a policy on new tasks when the world model has never seen target-task rollouts and the reward source is also task-agnostic. Prior imagined-RL pipelines reduce real-world interaction cost, but they still depend on target-task data to train or adapt the world model, and often require task-specific reward classifiers or reference trajectories. That makes them hard to scale to unseen tasks. RAW-Dream reframes the setup: pretrain a reusable action-conditioned world model on broad interaction data, use a frozen VLM as a zero-shot reward judge over imagined videos plus instructions, and adapt only the policy with a small amount of demonstrations followed by RL inside the frozen simulator.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is not a new backbone but a cleaner decomposition of what should be pretrained once versus adapted per task. The world model is treated as a reusable physical prior rather than a task-bound simulator, and the reward is outsourced to a general VLM instead of a task-specific learned head. For pretraining-oriented readers, this matters because it shifts the scaling question from 'how much target-task data do I need to build a simulator' to 'how broad and transferable can my embodiment-level physical prior become.' It also gives a concrete pretrain-to-posttrain interface: prepare a task-agnostic simulator and reward mechanism once, then spend downstream data only on policy anchoring. That is a meaningful change in data allocation, not just a small algorithmic tweak.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three core pieces. First, a task-agnostic action-conditioned video world model. The implementation is built on WAN 2.1, but the important design choice is the training constraint: the world model is trained only on broad, target-task-independent interaction data such as play data or non-overlapping benchmark tasks. The goal is to learn transferable physical dynamics rather than task templates.

Second, zero-shot reward from a frozen VLM. Instead of training a reward model for each task, the method feeds imagined rollout videos and the language instruction into Qwen3-VL and asks for binary success judgments. This removes the need for task-specific reward supervision. The trade-off is clear: less reward shaping and less task specialization, in exchange for much better reuse across tasks.

Third, policy optimization inside the frozen world model. The policy backbone is OpenVLA-OFT. It is first lightly supervised with a few demonstrations to bind the policy to the new task semantics, then optimized with GRPO entirely in imagination. Because unseen-task rollouts from a generative world model can produce hallucinated successes, the paper adds a dual-noise verification mechanism: generate rollouts under different diffusion noise seeds from the same initial condition, and accept the reward only when the VLM judgment is consistent across them. This is a targeted defense against reward hacking induced by world-model hallucination. A success that appears only under one noise realization is treated as unreliable.

The novelty is therefore mostly in the system design and the constraints, not in inventing a new VLA, VLM, or video diffusion model. RAW-Dream turns existing components into a strictly task-agnostic post-training loop and adds the minimum extra machinery needed to make that loop stable on unseen tasks.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers both simulation and real robots. In simulation, the world model is trained only on LIBERO-90 data, while four held-out suites—Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long—are used as downstream tasks that are completely unseen during world-model training. This is a stronger test than the usual low-data adaptation setting because the simulator has zero exposure to the target tasks. RAW-Dream improves over a 1-shot SFT baseline by +8.9% and outperforms online RL despite the latter using 50x more real-world data. That comparison is important: the method is not merely data-efficient at the cost of weak performance; it is competitive in a regime where real interaction is expensive.

On real robots, the world model is pretrained only on diverse, uncurated play data, again without target-task rollouts. Each new task starts from a 3-shot SFT policy and is then refined through imagined RL. The reported gain is +21.7% absolute success rate over the 3-shot SFT baseline. For robotic manipulation, that is a large enough margin to show that the imagined training signal is doing real work rather than producing simulator-only improvements.

The most important ablations appear to be: whether a task-agnostic world model can support unseen-task adaptation at all, whether zero-shot VLM reward is reliable enough to drive RL, and whether dual-noise verification reduces hallucinated success and false-positive reward hacking. Even without every table reproduced here, the paper’s empirical case depends on this combination rather than on a single headline number.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem definition in the introduction. The phrase to keep in mind is 'target-task-agnostic VLA-RL optimization in world models.' That is the real claim. Then read the method section with attention to the interfaces: how the imagined video is produced, how Qwen3-VL is prompted to score success, what is frozen versus trainable, and how GRPO consumes the filtered rewards. The dual-noise verification mechanism deserves close reading because it addresses a failure mode that is easy to miss if one only looks at average success rates.

In the experiments, focus on the exact train-test split for LIBERO and the real-robot setup using only play data for world-model pretraining. Those details determine whether the results truly demonstrate transferable physical priors or just hidden task overlap. If time is limited, read the pipeline figure, the main LIBERO table, the ablation on reward verification, and the real-robot results. If reading deeply, ask two questions: is the main bottleneck coverage of interaction data or fidelity of the generative world model, and is VLM-based reward merely noisy or systematically biased on imagined videos. Expect roughly 45–70 minutes for a careful pass, longer if you also inspect appendices and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和实验表；若结果扎实，它会改变 VLA 后训练里“每任务重训 world/reward”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and main tables; if the results hold, it weakens the default of retraining world and reward models per VLA task.

paper.title: ForgeVLA: Federated Vision-Language-Action Learning without Language Annotations

Fortunately, vision-equipped robots deployed across various domains already produce abundant vision-action pairs that can be leveraged to scale up VLA training more efficiently. However, these raw data cannot be centrally aggregated due to various constraints and also exhibit severe heterogeneit

summary.core_problem: 解决机器人 VLA 训练中，分布式 vision-action 数据无法集中、且缺少语言标注导致难以扩展的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献点在联邦式 VLA 训练框架和无语言标注下的 triplet 构造，和多模态统一预训练有边缘相关性，但更偏机器人数据管线而非基座建模。
summary.technical_approach: ForgeVLA 在每个客户端部署 embodied instruction classifier，把 vision-action 对映射到预定义指令集合，补出语言模态形成 V-L-A triplet；随后在联邦学习设定下处理跨客户端异构性，联合训练 VLA 模型而不汇聚原始数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模。实验应围绕分布式机器人数据、无标注语言恢复质量、联邦训练稳定性和下游操控性能展开。对预训练研究员更值得看的部分是：缺失模态如何被离散 instruction set 近似恢复，以及这种弱语言监督是否足够支撑统一建模。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自四川大学、浙江大学。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles scalable VLA training when robot-generated vision-action data are distributed, heterogeneous, and lack language annotations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a federated VLA framework with pseudo-language recovery. It is only tangentially relevant to multimodal pretraining, leaning more toward robotics data pipelines than foundation-model modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: ForgeVLA equips each client with an embodied instruction classifier that maps vision-action pairs into a predefined instruction set, creating pseudo vision-language-action triplets. It then performs federated training while handling client heterogeneity without centralizing raw data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size. The evaluation likely studies distributed robot datasets, pseudo-language recovery quality, federated robustness, and downstream control performance. For pretraining researchers, the interesting angle is whether weak recovered language is sufficient for unified modeling.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Sichuan University and Zhejiang University.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练的交集只在“缺失语言模态如何补齐”这个点；若你关心 VLA 数据构造，可只看 pseudo-instruction 设计与异构客户端处理。
recommendation.en: The only real pretraining-adjacent idea is how missing language is reconstructed; if you care about VLA data formation, read the pseudo-instruction design and heterogeneity handling, nothing more.

However, existing datasets are often limited by short episode durations, typically spanning only a few minutes, which fails to capture the long horizon temporal dependencies necessary for complex robotic task execution. To bridge this gap, we present MobileEgo Anywhere, a framework designed to facilitate the collection of robust, hour plus egocentric trajectories using

summary.core_problem: 降低长时程第一视角数据采集门槛，为 VLA 和具身模型提供小时级、带持续状态跟踪的 egocentric trajectories。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态/VLA 数据基础设施和数据集。它不提出新的统一建模目标，但长时程 egocentric 数据对机器人和 VLA 预训练很重要，尤其是补足现有短片段数据难以覆盖长期依赖的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MobileEgo Anywhere，用普通智能手机采集长时程第一视角轨迹。方法利用手机传感器套件进行长期相机位姿跟踪，避免传统机器人硬件和专用采集设备带来的成本与规模限制，并开源移动端采集应用。
summary.experiments: 发布约 200 小时的多样化长形式 egocentric 数据，包含 persistent state tracking。摘要未给出 VLA 模型训练结果、下游任务提升、baseline 或定量对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper lowers the barrier for collecting long-horizon egocentric trajectories for VLA and embodied models using commodity mobile hardware.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal/VLA data infrastructure contribution. It does not introduce a new modeling objective, but long-form egocentric data is relevant for pretraining embodied models that need temporal dependencies beyond short clips.
summary_en.technical_approach: MobileEgo Anywhere uses modern smartphones to record hour-plus egocentric trajectories. It leverages phone sensor suites for long-term camera pose tracking, reducing dependence on expensive robotics hardware, and releases a mobile app for data collection.
summary_en.experiments: The release contains around 200 hours of diverse long-form egocentric data with persistent state tracking. The abstract does not report VLA training results, downstream gains, baselines, or quantitative comparisons.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with FPV Labs.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLA 数据来源记一笔即可；没有训练曲线和消融，暂不改数据配比判断。
recommendation.en: Log it as a possible VLA data source; without training curves or ablations, it should not change data-mixture priors.

paper.title: Being-H0.7: A Latent World-Action Model from Egocentric Videos
paper.abstract: Visual-Language-Action models (VLAs) have advanced generalist robot control by mapping multimodal observations and language instructions directly to actions, but sparse action supervision often encourages shortcut mappings rather than representations of dynamics, contact, and task progress. Recent world-action models introduce future prediction through video rollouts, yet pixel-space prediction is a costly and indirect substrate for control, as it may model visual details irrelevant to action ge

summary.core_problem: 在机器人 VLA 策略中引入未来感知的世界模型能力，同时避免像素级视频 rollout 带来的训练和推理开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是具身多模态策略中的方法创新：把未来预测从显式视频生成转为隐变量接口，对 latent reasoning 和 action-conditioned representation 有一定参考价值，但仍主要服务机器人控制。
summary.technical_approach: Being-H0.7 在感知模块和动作头之间插入可学习 latent queries，作为紧凑的推理接口。训练时使用双分支设计：部署时可用的 prior branch 只从当前上下文推断 latent state；训练期 posterior branch 引入未来信息，为 latent 表示提供监督或对齐信号，从而让策略获得未来感知但不生成未来帧。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露参数量、训练数据规模、机器人基准、具体 baseline 和提升幅度。可确认的是论文定位为 VLA/world-action model，对比对象应包括直接 VLA 策略和像素空间未来预测式 world-action model。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to add future-aware world-modeling capability to VLA-style robot policies without paying the cost of pixel-space video rollouts.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a method-level change for embodied multimodal policies: replacing explicit future-frame generation with a latent reasoning interface. This is relevant to latent reasoning and action-conditioned representation learning, but remains mainly a robotics-control paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: Being-H0.7 inserts learnable latent queries between perception and action as a compact reasoning bottleneck. It uses a dual-branch training scheme: a deployable prior branch infers latent states from the current context, while a training-only posterior branch uses future information to shape or align the latent representation, enabling future-aware control without generating future frames.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter counts, training-data scale, benchmark names, baseline details, or numerical gains. The intended comparisons are direct VLA policies and pixel-space future-prediction world-action models.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和双分支训练细节；latent future supervision 的思路可借鉴，机器人实验本身不用深读。
recommendation.en: Read only the method diagram and dual-branch training details; the latent future supervision idea transfers, the robotics results less so.

paper.title: PRTS: A Primitive Reasoning and Tasking System via Contrastive Representations
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models advance robotic control via strong visual-linguistic priors. However, existing VLAs predominantly frame pretraining as supervised behavior cloning, overlooking the fundamental nature of robot learning as a goal-reaching process that requires understanding temporal task progress. We present \textbf{PRTS} (\textbf{P}rimitive \textbf{R}easoning and \textbf{T}asking \textbf{S}ystem), a VLA foundation model that reformulates pretraining through Goal-Conditioned Rei

summary.core_problem: 现有 VLA 预训练多把机器人学习当作监督行为克隆，难以显式建模任务进展和语言目标的物理可达性。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把 VLA 预训练从静态语义匹配推进到目标可达性建模。对多模态基座研究的价值主要是训练信号设计：语言不只作为标签或指令，而作为 goal-conditioned RL 中的目标表征。
summary.technical_approach: PRTS 使用 Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning 重写 VLA 预训练目标。方法用对比式强化学习学习统一嵌入空间，使 state-action embedding 与 goal embedding 的内积近似 log-discounted goal occupancy，即从当前状态动作到达语言目标的概率，从而提供比行为克隆更密集的可达性监督。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明训练监督来自离线机器人数据，并面向 VLA 控制任务验证；给定信息未包含具体模型规模、数据量、baseline 名称和数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括中国电信人工智能研究院、清华大学、上海交通大学、复旦大学等。

summary_en.core_problem: Current VLA pretraining often treats robot learning as supervised behavior cloning and does not explicitly model task progress or physical goal reachability.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a pretraining objective that moves VLA learning from static semantic matching toward goal-reachability estimation. Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is in how language can serve as a goal signal rather than only an instruction label.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRTS reformulates VLA pretraining with goal-conditioned reinforcement learning. It uses contrastive RL to learn a shared embedding space where the inner product between state-action and goal embeddings approximates log-discounted goal occupancy, providing dense supervision for whether a language-specified goal is reachable.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates that supervision is drawn from offline robot data and evaluated on VLA control settings, but the provided information does not include model scale, data scale, baselines, or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include TeleAI, China Telecom, Tsinghua University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and Fudan University.

recommendation.zh: 机器人味道较重；只看 goal occupancy 训练目标，能借鉴到多模态预训练的可达性信号，别外推到文本 LM。
recommendation.en: Robotics-heavy; read the goal-occupancy objective as a transferable supervision design for multimodal pretraining, not as evidence about text LM training.

paper.title: LaST-R1: Reinforcing Action via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning for VLA Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have increasingly incorporated reasoning mechanisms for complex robotic manipulation. However, existing approaches share a critical limitation: whether employing explicit linguistic reasoning that suffers from latency and discretization, or utilizing more expressive continuous latent reasoning, they are predominantly confined to static imitation learning that limits adaptability and generalization. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是 VLA 中一个很具体但重要的缺口：已有带 reasoning 的机器人策略，要么依赖显式语言推理，延迟高且难表达连续物理过程；要么做 latent reasoning，但训练方式仍主要是 imitation learning，缺少在线交互带来的适应性。与此同时，已有 VLA 的 RL post-training 又大多只优化 action space，没有把“先形成物理推理，再执行动作”这一内部过程纳入优化目标。作者的问题设定因此很明确：能否让 RL 直接作用于 latent physical reasoning 与 action generation 的耦合过程，而不是只在动作层面做 policy improvement。
summary.importance: 它对纯 LLM 预训练的直接价值有限，因为主要是机器人 VLA post-training；但对“latent reasoning 是否能被训练信号显式塑形”这个更一般的问题有启发。尤其是两点。第一，作者把 latent CoT 当作隐式决策变量，而不是中间副产物，这和近来语言模型里对 latent reasoning、hidden scratchpad、continuous thought 的兴趣是同一方向。第二，LAPO 的核心思想是把环境奖励通过联合 likelihood ratio 传回 reasoning token 与 action token，这提供了一种 credit assignment 视角：如果中间推理不可见，仍然可以通过策略梯度间接塑造它。对研究 RL-pretrain、reasoning token、或 post-train 反哺内部表征的人，这个思路值得记一下。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 LaST-R1 架构。模型以预训练 Qwen3-VL-4B 为初始化，在机器人数据上继续预训练。执行时先自回归地产生 latent reasoning tokens，再以这些 latent token 为条件并行解码动作。这里 latent token 不是语言解释，而是连续或离散化后的内部推理表征，用来编码物理动态、未来状态和操作意图。作者还用 vision foundation model 的 global future representations 去 anchor 这些 latent token，目的是给 latent reasoning 一个稳定的语义/空间先验，避免它在训练中退化成无意义隐变量。第二部分是 LAPO。与只对动作概率做 PPO 式优化不同，LAPO 把 latent reasoning 和 action generation 放进统一的 step-level likelihood ratio 中，让环境奖励同时影响两者。直观上，策略不只是学“哪个动作回报高”，还学“哪种内部物理表征更有助于产生高回报动作”。这解决的是 credit assignment：奖励来自环境终局，但更新要能传到中间 reasoning。第三部分是 adaptive latent CoT。作者不固定 reasoning horizon，而是让模型根据任务复杂度动态调整 latent reasoning 长度。复杂任务多想几步，反应型任务少想甚至近似跳过，以平衡性能和时延。训练流程上，先做大规模机器人预训练，再对具体任务做 SFT warm-up，最后进入在线 RL post-training。
summary.experiments: 从引言可确认的关键结果包括：模型以 Qwen3-VL-4B 为底座，在多个机器人操作数据集上预训练；在 LIBERO benchmark 上，one-shot warm-up 后平均成功率达到 99.8%，高于已有基线；在四个真实世界复杂任务上，LAPO 相比 warm-up 初始策略最高带来 44% 提升，单臂和双臂场景平均成功率达到 90%；RL 后训练后还能对未见物体、背景、光照实现 zero-shot generalization。实验主线大致有三类。第一，和 vanilla action-only RL policy 比较，证明联合优化 latent reasoning + action 比只优化动作更稳、更能泛化。第二，验证 adaptive latent CoT 的收益，说明固定推理长度不是最优折中。第三，真实机器人实验说明改进不只存在于仿真。由于给出的全文片段主要是引言，具体消融数字、训练步数、rollout 配置、奖励设计细节还需要看实验章节原文才能完整确认；但从问题设定和结果摘要看，作者想证明的核心命题已经很清楚：latent reasoning 不是只能靠 imitation 学，也可以被在线 RL 直接塑形。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看 Figure 1 对比 action-only RL 与 reasoning-before-acting RL 的差异，这是整篇工作的主轴。然后重点读方法部分里 LaST-R1 的生成顺序：latent token 如何产生、如何条件化动作解码、future representation 如何做 anchor。接着读 LAPO 的目标函数，尤其是联合 likelihood ratio 怎么写、与 PPO 的差别在哪里、奖励如何分配到 reasoning token。若你关心语言模型里的 latent reasoning，这部分最值得细看。实验部分优先看三组对比：有无 latent reasoning、有无 LAPO、固定与自适应 reasoning horizon。真实机器人结果也建议看，因为它决定这类方法是不是只在仿真里成立。若时间有限，可以先跳过具体任务描述和视觉展示，保留算法公式、训练流程图、主表和关键消融表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific gap in VLA training. Existing reasoning-enabled robot policies either rely on explicit language reasoning, which is slow and poorly matched to continuous physical dynamics, or use latent reasoning but still train mostly with imitation learning, limiting adaptation. Meanwhile, online RL for VLA usually optimizes only the action space and ignores the internal reasoning process. The central question here is whether RL can optimize the coupled process of latent physical reasoning and action generation, rather than improving actions alone.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to core LLM pretraining is modest, since this is primarily a robotics VLA post-training paper. Still, it is useful for a broader line of work around latent reasoning. Two aspects stand out. First, latent CoT is treated as an actual decision variable rather than an incidental hidden state. That connects naturally to current interest in hidden scratchpads, continuous thought, and latent reasoning in language models. Second, LAPO offers a concrete credit-assignment mechanism: even when intermediate reasoning is not externally supervised, environmental reward can still shape it through a joint policy objective over reasoning and action tokens. That idea is relevant to anyone thinking about RL-pretrain, internal reasoning representations, or how post-training can sculpt hidden computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has three main components. First, the LaST-R1 architecture. It is initialized from Qwen3-VL-4B and further pretrained on large-scale robotic manipulation datasets. At inference time, the model autoregressively generates latent reasoning tokens before producing actions, and those latent tokens condition a parallel action decoder. These tokens are not natural-language explanations; they are internal reasoning representations intended to capture physical dynamics, future state structure, and manipulation intent. To stabilize them, the authors anchor the latent reasoning space to global future representations from a vision foundation model, providing semantic and spatial priors so the latent variables do not drift into arbitrary hidden codes. Second, LAPO, or Latent-to-Action Policy Optimization. Instead of applying PPO-style optimization only to action probabilities, LAPO defines a joint step-level likelihood ratio over latent reasoning and action generation. This allows environmental reward to influence both the internal reasoning trajectory and the final action policy. The key benefit is better credit assignment: the reward arrives from interaction outcomes, but the update can still reach the intermediate reasoning process. Third, the adaptive latent CoT mechanism. Rather than fixing a constant reasoning horizon, the model adjusts the amount of latent reasoning based on task demands. Harder tasks can allocate more internal computation, while reactive tasks can use shorter reasoning for lower latency. The overall training recipe is pretraining on robotic data, task-specific SFT warm-up, and then online RL post-training.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-text excerpt, the main confirmed results are as follows: the model is built on Qwen3-VL-4B and pretrained on multiple robotic manipulation datasets; on LIBERO, it reaches a 99.8% average success rate with one-shot warm-up, outperforming prior baselines; on four real-world complex tasks, LAPO improves over the warm-up policy by up to 44%, reaching a 90% average success rate across single-arm and dual-arm settings; after RL post-training, the system also shows zero-shot generalization to unseen objects, backgrounds, and lighting conditions. The experimental story appears to have three pillars. First, comparisons against vanilla action-only RL policies show that jointly optimizing latent reasoning and actions improves robustness and generalization. Second, adaptive latent CoT is evaluated against fixed reasoning horizons, supporting the claim that reasoning depth should be task-dependent. Third, real-robot experiments indicate the gains are not confined to simulation. Since the provided text is mostly the introduction, exact ablation numbers, rollout settings, reward definitions, and training budgets still need to be checked in the full experimental section. Even so, the intended claim is already clear: latent reasoning does not have to be learned only through imitation; it can be directly shaped by online RL.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 40 minutes. Start with Figure 1, which contrasts action-only RL with reasoning-before-acting RL; that figure captures the paper’s main thesis. Then read the method section for the generation order in LaST-R1: how latent tokens are produced, how they condition action decoding, and how future representations are used as anchors. After that, focus on the LAPO objective, especially how the joint likelihood ratio is defined and how it differs from standard PPO. If your interest is latent reasoning in language models, this is the most transferable part. In the experiments, prioritize three comparisons: with versus without latent reasoning, with versus without LAPO, and fixed versus adaptive reasoning horizon. The real-world robot section is also worth reading because it tests whether the method survives outside simulation. If time is limited, skip detailed task descriptions and visual examples, and keep the algorithm equations, training pipeline figure, main result tables, and key ablations.

recommendation.zh: 多模态VLA模型RL后训练的创新方法，仅需读方法部分§3的LAPO算法设计即可

paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are promising for generalist robot control, but on-robot deployment is bottlenecked by real-time inference under tight cost and energy budgets. summary.core_problem: 研究 Vision-Language-Action 模型在机器人端侧部署时，如何在成本、能耗和控制时延约束下选择硬件并做推理加速。
summary.importance: 这是 VLA 部署效率分析和系统优化工作。它不直接改进预训练，但对多模态模型从云端 benchmark 走向机器人实时控制时的瓶颈拆解有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建跨 GPU/XPU/NPU 的模型-硬件评测，使用 CET，即 Cost、Energy、Time，刻画部署权衡。通过 profiling 发现 VLA 推理存在两个阶段：计算受限的 VLM backbone 和内存受限的 Action Expert。基于该观察提出 DP-Cache 和 V-AEFusion，用于减少 diffusion/action 相关推理开销和阶段间低利用率。
summary.experiments: 实验包括跨加速器 leaderboard、模型-硬件配对的 CET 对比，以及对 VLM backbone 和 Action Expert 的细粒度 profiling。摘要称合适尺寸的边缘设备在满足控制频率时可比旗舰 GPU 更具成本和能耗效率，但未给出具体数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Jiao Tong University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to deploy Vision-Language-Action models on robots under strict cost, energy, and real-time control constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency and systems analysis paper for VLA deployment. It does not directly change pretraining, but it gives useful evidence about where multimodal action models spend compute and memory at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a cross-accelerator evaluation across GPUs, XPUs, and NPUs using CET: Cost, Energy, and Time. Profiling reveals a two-phase inference pattern: a compute-bound VLM backbone followed by a memory-bound Action Expert. The proposed DP-Cache and V-AEFusion target the diffusion/action-stage overhead and phase-dependent underutilization.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include a cross-accelerator leaderboard, CET comparisons for model-hardware pairs, and detailed profiling of the VLM backbone and Action Expert. The abstract claims that right-sized edge devices can be more cost- and energy-efficient than flagship GPUs while meeting control-rate constraints, but does not provide exact numbers.

summary.core_problem: 解决 Vision-Language-Action 系统在多步任务中一旦中间步骤偏离，就会层层放大并形成 cascading failures 的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 VLA/agent 方向的训练框架改进，价值在于把纠错从事后修补改成分层预测式校正，并提出误差传播与恢复指标；对基座预训练只有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReCAPA（摘要中也称 Predictive Alignment and Planning Architecture），在 action、subgoal、trajectory 三个层级同时做预测与对比式校正。通过 Sinkhorn-based semantic alignment 模块和 score-field 模块约束多层语义一致性，并把预测纠偏信号回传给 action generator 联合训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调在多步 multimodal task 中缓解误差累积，并新增两个指标来量化 error propagation 与 recovery，但未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模、提升幅度或与主流 VLA baseline 的完整数字。整体更像任务层系统改进，而非可迁移到 LLM 预训练的 clean setup。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港科技大学（广州）和华南师范大学，属于具身/多模态决策方向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses cascading failures in Vision-Language-Action systems, where an early mistake in a multi-step task propagates and compounds over time.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLA/agent training-framework paper. Its main value is shifting from post-hoc correction to hierarchical predictive correction and introducing metrics for error propagation and recovery, with only indirect relevance to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReCAPA, referred to in the abstract as a Predictive Alignment and Planning Architecture, performs predictive and contrastive correction at three levels: actions, subgoals, and trajectories. It uses a Sinkhorn-based semantic alignment module and a score-field module to enforce consistency, and jointly updates the action generator during training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improved robustness on multi-step multimodal tasks and introduces two new metrics for quantifying propagation and recovery of errors, but does not provide concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or full baseline comparisons. The setup appears more task-system oriented than a clean pretraining study.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from HKUST (Guangzhou) and South China Normal University, working in embodied and multimodal decision-making.

paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) inherit their visual and linguistic capabilities from Vision-Language Models (VLMs), yet most VLAs are built from off-the-shelf VLMs that are not adapted to the embodied domain, limiting their downstream performance. summary.core_problem: 现有视觉语言动作模型（VLA）大多采用通用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）作为骨干网络，VLM预训练数据分布和VLA所用的机器人交互轨迹数据分布存在显著差异，直接微调VLM无法有效适配具身场景，限制了VLA的下游性能。

summary.technical_approach: 提出EmbodiedMidtrain框架，首先训练一个轻量 proximity 估计器，在冻结的VLM特征上做二分类区分VLA和VLM数据，输出的分数作为每个VLM样本与VLA域的对齐度；从大规模VLM数据池中选出对齐度最高的样本组成中期训练数据集，用该数据集对VLM做中期训练后，再作为VLA微调的初始化。该方法不需要修改VLM或VLA的架构，可扩展性强。

summary.reading_guide: 重点关注数据分布差异分析、proximity估计器设计和跨架构迁移实验部分，预计阅读时间25分钟，无需深挖机器人任务的具体评测细节，优先关注中期训练的数据选择逻辑和效果。

summary_en.core_problem: Most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models use off-the-shelf general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbones, which have a significant distribution gap between VLM pretraining data and VLA robotic interaction trajectory data. Direct fine-tuning of VLMs cannot effectively adapt to embodied scenarios, limiting downstream VLA performance.
summary_en.importance: It validates the value of mid-training for cross-domain model initialization. The proposed data selection method improves VLA initialization adaptability at low cost, which provides reference for optimizing the pipeline from multimodal pretraining to vertical domain adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The EmbodiedMidtrain framework is proposed. First, a lightweight proximity estimator is trained to classify VLA and VLM data on frozen VLM features, and the output score is used as the alignment degree between each VLM sample and the VLA domain. The highest-aligned samples are selected from a large VLM pool to form a mid-training dataset, which is used to mid-train the VLM before VLA fine-tuning. No architectural changes to VLMs or VLAs are required, and the pipeline is scalable.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on three embodied robot benchmarks: Calvin ABC-D, SimplerEnv Bridge, and Libero-10. The 1.1B parameter mid-trained model achieves significant performance gains. The curated dataset transfers across architectures: the mixture selected with InternVL3.5-1B also brings consistent gains on Qwen3VL-2B. The learned proximity estimator outperforms hand-crafted metrics like feature space distance and perplexity. The advantage of mid-training emerges from the earliest fine-tuning steps and widens over time, indicating it provides a fundamentally better initialization rather than a transient head start.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the data distribution gap analysis, proximity estimator design, and cross-architecture transfer experiments. Estimated reading time is 25 minutes. No need to dive into specific evaluation details of robotic tasks, prioritize the data selection logic and effect of mid-training.

recommendation.zh: 将 mid-training 概念引入具身 VLA 领域，其数据筛选引擎（proximity estimator）的设计对跨域数据混合有一定参考价值，建议关注其数据分布差异的量化分析部分。
recommendation.en: Introduces mid-training to embodied VLAs; the design of the proximity estimator for data filtering offers insights for cross-domain data mixing. The quantitative analysis of distribution gaps is worth skimming.

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型缺乏显式动作数据的问题，评估从人类视频中提取的隐式动作表示的有效性。
summary.importance: 构建了一个大规模基准测试（LARY），用于评估隐式动作表示在高级语义动作和低级机器人控制上的泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 收集并整理了包含 100 万个视频（1000 小时）、151 个动作类别的大规模数据集，统一评估视觉信号到本体无关表示的转换质量。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 62 万图像对和 59.5 万运动轨迹，跨越多种具身环境，揭示了通用视觉基础模型在动作对齐上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the scarcity of explicit action data for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by evaluating latent action representations extracted from human videos.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a large-scale benchmark (LARY) to evaluate the generalization of latent action representations on both semantic actions and low-level robotic control.
summary_en.technical_approach: Curates a dataset of 1M videos (1,000 hours) across 151 action categories to uniformly evaluate the transformation of visual signals into ontology-independent representations.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset includes 620K image pairs and 595K motion trajectories across diverse embodiments, revealing the performance of general visual foundation models on action alignment.

recommendation.zh: 具身 VLM 领域的优质数据基准，对 vision-to-action 对齐有参考价值，不涉足机器人控制的预训练研究员可跳过。
recommendation.en: Solid benchmark for VLA alignment; useful for embodied AI data curation, but can be skipped if not working on robotics.

paper.title: StarVLA-$α$: Reducing Complexity in Vision-Language-Action Systems

summary.core_problem: VLA(视觉-语言-动作)机器人系统设计高度碎片化，如何用低复杂度强基线在统一设置下厘清关键设计因素并获得有竞争力的性能。
summary.importance: 范式/系统化贡献：提供“简单但强”的VLA基线以减少工程与架构混杂因素，便于研究者在统一多基准训练下做可控消融；对多模态对齐到动作空间的研究有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出StarVLA-α：刻意降低架构与训练管线复杂度，围绕动作建模策略、机器人特定预训练、接口工程等关键轴重新评估；强调强VLM backbone + 最小化设计即可达到强表现。
summary.experiments: 在LIBERO、SimplerEnv、RoboTwin、RoboCasa上进行统一多benchmark训练与对比；结论是该简单基线仍保持高度竞争力（摘要未给出参数规模、数据规模与具体提升数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language-action (VLA) robotics systems are highly fragmented, making it hard to identify which design choices matter and to build a low-complexity yet competitive baseline under a unified training/evaluation setting.
summary_en.importance: By emphasizing a deliberately simple but strong VLA baseline, the work reduces confounding engineering complexity and enables more controlled ablations across multiple benchmarks, clarifying practical design factors for mapping multimodal inputs to actions.
summary_en.technical_approach: StarVLA-α intentionally simplifies architecture and training pipelines, re-examining key axes such as action modeling strategy, robot-specific pretraining, and interface/engineering choices, and argues that a strong VLM backbone plus minimal additional design can achieve strong performance.
summary_en.experiments: The system is trained and compared under a unified multi-benchmark setup on LIBERO, SimplerEnv, RoboTwin, and RoboCasa, showing competitive performance despite reduced complexity; the summary does not include parameter counts, data scale, or detailed metrics.
